stories.title: QR code to highlight accident-prone zones on 4 highways:'Mission Safer Road' launched to curb mishaps; maps to point 121 blackspots
stories.summary: In Rajasthan, the 'Mission Safer Road' initiative has been launched to prevent accidents on highways. The police have issued a QR code. After scanning it, accident spots on 4 national highways passing through Jaipur (Delhi, Sikar, Ajmer and Agra) will appear on Google Maps. While driving, as soon as you scan the QR code, the distance to black spots will also start showing and the driver will become alert. Now you must be wondering To find answers to these questions, a Bhaskar reporter went to the highway and did a reality check. Read the full report The Bhaskar reporter first went to the Jaipur-Ajmer highway. As soon as we entered the highway, we scanned the QR code issued by the police and turned on the map. Different pre-marked spots started appearing at various locations on the map. Three spots were found within a 55-kilometer radius. The first spot was found approximately 30 kilometers after the 200 Feet Bypass bus stop while going towards Ajmer, at Mahla Mod. At this location, 27 accidents have occurred in the last three years. As soon as you click on the spot in the map, it tells you everything about that place, such as what type of spot it is and how many accidents have occurred. There is also a school at a short distance from this spot. People nearby informed that there is a turn a little ahead from here, due to which there is a risk of accidents happening here. Just 50 meters away from this is a flyover, from which vehicles coming down are also at speed. Local villager Narsilal Sharma said that accidents have happened here several times in front of him. When asked about the QR code, he said that he was not aware of it, but he knows this much that this place comes under the accident risk zone. One and a half kilometers after this, at Nasnoda Cut, there is a low risk zone spot, where 14 accidents have occurred in the last three years. Moving forward from here on the Ajmer Highway, 5 kilometers ahead, just past the Mokhampura intersection, a red zone appears on the map. This is a high-risk zone, meaning an A-type spot. According to the survey conducted by police for the QR code, 36 accidents occurred here between 2023-25. We spoke with truck driver Mukesh Shah standing at the petrol pump here. When asked about the map, he said that until now he was not aware of such a map. He says that if such spots are shown on the map, he will definitely use it. After this, the Bhaskar reporter conducted a reality check on National Highway Number 8 between Jaipur and Delhi. Here, about 37 kilometers from Jaipur in Achrol, the first black spot on this highway was found. This was at a place where underpass construction was ongoing. There are markets and crowds on both sides of the highway. This place had a yellow alert spot, where 16 accidents have occurred in the last three years. Raju Saini from the area said that work keeps going on here. This has made the road narrow. Due to this, two-wheelers often become victims of accidents. Black spots divided into 3 zones Police have identified 121 black spots. At these spots, 1108 people have died in 3 years. These spots have been divided into 3 different zones - Red, Orange and Yellow. According to the police survey, 162 deaths occurred at 6 red zone spots, 475 deaths at 37 orange zone spots and 471 deaths at 78 yellow zone spots.

stories.title: Why stars are saying ‘Radhe-Radhe’ to the glamour world?:Has Radha's devotion surpassed Krishna worship? People visit Vrindavan in search of peace
stories.summary: There was once a life filled with dazzling lights, camera glamour and crores earned through films and television serials. Today, many celebrities are seen wearing tulsi garlands, applying tilak on their foreheads and chanting “Radhe-Radhe” in the lanes of Vrindavan. Actors and public figures who once lived in the world of glamour are now turning towards spirituality in search of peace. From Savdhaan India fame Ana Jaysinghani to actor Anushka Sharma, several celebrities have embraced devotion to Radha and the simple lifestyle associated with saints in Vrindavan. Ana left the television industry, while Anushka Sharma has not appeared in films since 2018. Over the past few years, Vrindavan has increasingly emerged as a centre for spiritual calm and devotion. Apart from Anushka and Ana, celebrities such as Shilpa Shetty, Hema Malini, Ashutosh Rana and singer Mika Singh have also spoken about their spiritual experiences after meeting Premanand Maharaj and have become associated with devotional practices centred around Radha. This time in Sunday Big Story, we understand the rising graph of Radha devotion... The chants of “Radhe-Radhe” are now echoing through the lanes and temples of Vrindavan alongside devotion to Lord Krishna. A growing number of devotees are immersing themselves in this changing spiritual atmosphere. Earlier, visitors would come mainly for darshan at the Banke Bihari Temple, explore the lanes of Vrindavan and then return home. Now, many devotees also travel to Barsana, believed to be the village of Radha, to visit the Shri Ji Temple. Large numbers of young people are spending several days in places such as Govardhan, Barsana and Vrindavan, living a simple, ascetic lifestyle and attending spiritual discourses at Premanand Maharaj’s Shri Keli Kunj Ashram. Sant Premanand Maharaj has emerged as a major influence behind this growing devotional environment. Through Radha Keli Kunj and padyatras (foot pilgrimages), he has inspired devotees visiting Vrindavan to connect with Radha Naam Sankirtan. Along with increasing spiritual interest, this trend has also significantly boosted the business of local Braj traders dealing in Laddu Gopal idols, devotional attire and garlands. From TV Serials to Devotion to Radha Ana Jaysinghani, originally from Madhya Pradesh’s Gwalior district, moved to Mumbai in 2011. She trained with Ekta Kapoor’s Balaji Telefilms and later worked as a freelance choreographer with Thomas Paulson and Salman Khan. She also appeared in television shows such as Savdhaan India, Sony TV’s Dekha Ek Khwaab and Fear Files, gaining recognition through her performances. Speaking about her spiritual journey, Ana said she first visited Vrindavan as a tourist but felt deeply transformed by the experience. She stopped consuming onion and garlic and later claimed that Premanand Maharaj appeared in her dream, asking her to chant Radha’s name. She said this inspired her to dedicate herself to spirituality. On Basant Panchami in January 2026, she took initiation from Premanand Maharaj and decided to settle in Vrindavan. “Earlier, I was surrounded by glitz and glamour. Now I have found peace here,” she said. Anushka visited Premanand Maharaj 3 times in 5 months Tulsi Mala around neck, no longer seen in films Anushka Sharma was last seen in the film Zero in 2018. On July 4, 2023, Anushka reached out to meet Premanand Maharaj with her husband Virat Kohli. Then, in 3 years, Anushka and Virat visited Premanand Maharaj 4 times. Recently, when Anushka and Virat met Premanand Maharaj, a tulsi mala was seen around their necks. This mala is usually worn by people who have taken diksha (spiritual initiation). There is talk that Anushka has also taken diksha. Some other Bollywood stars who came close to Radha Naam Premanand says, 'Whatever the problem, the solution is only Radha's name' In the era of social media, a saint's 'simplicity' and the echo of 'Radha's name' are drawing people towards him. He goes from Shri Krishna Sharanam Society to Kelikunj Ashram every day. Thousands of people used to arrive to see him at 2 AM at night. Currently, he goes to the ashram at 5 PM in the evening. They hold private meetings at Kelikunj Ashram. Videos of these are posted on the Bhajan Marg channel. Here, there are no complex mantras, but solutions to depression, career, and family complications are explained through the chanting of 'Radha Naam' alone. This is why youth are connecting with them the most. According to Tourism Department data, currently 1 to 1.5 lakh people reach Mathura-Vrindavan every day. On holidays and major festivals, this number increases up to 10 times. Now, let's understand the business in Mathura-Vrindavan…

stories.title: BJP Yuva Morcha leader shot in Lucknow:Attacker opens rapid fire on road; supporters protest at KGMU as condition remains critical
stories.summary: BJP Yuva Morcha leader Chetan Tiwari (30) was critically injured in a life-threatening attack in Lucknow on Saturday night after an assailant allegedly fired five rounds at him. The incident took place around 8 pm in the Mehndiganj area of Bazar Khala when Chetan was standing outside his house. According to police, the attacker arrived on foot and suddenly pointed a pistol at him. Chetan tried to save himself by ducking, but the first bullet struck him in the waist, causing him to collapse on the road. The attacker then reportedly moved closer and fired additional shots at close range, targeting his shoulder and neck. When nearby residents tried to intervene, the accused allegedly pointed the pistol at them as well, forcing them to step back. The assailant fled the scene shortly after the attack. Locals informed the police and rushed Chetan to the KGMU Trauma Center, where his condition remains critical. Following the incident, a large number of people gathered at the trauma centre and created a commotion demanding the immediate arrest of the accused. Police officials spent nearly an hour calming the crowd. CCTV footage of the attack has also surfaced. Police identified the accused as Vaibhav Vajpayee (30), who lives in the same neighbourhood as Chetan. He has been taken into custody and is being questioned. Police suspect the attack was linked to an old rivalry. The entire incident in 4 pictures What is visible in the CCTV? Chaos continued for a long time at the Trauma Center With the help of local people, the injured BJP Yuva Morcha leader was immediately taken to KGMU Trauma Center. His supporters and acquaintances also reached there. They started creating a commotion. Their demand was that the attacker should be identified and arrested as soon as possible. On receiving information, Bazarkhala police reached the spot. They inspected the crime scene. Station in-charge Brijesh Singh said that no complaint has been received in the case yet. Police are scanning the footage of CCTV cameras installed nearby. In the preliminary investigation, various points, including old rivalries, are being probed. See pictures of the commotion at KGMU- Vaibhav, a resident of the locality, fired the shot, old enmity the reason According to police, Chetan Tiwari works in hoarding installation. He had an ongoing dispute with Vaibhav Vajpayee, who lives in the same neighborhood. The reason for the dispute is said to be related to hoardings. In this grudge, he attacked Chetan. Police are interrogating Vaibhav. DCP West and an altercation among people

stories.title: Jhansi betting case reveals affair angle:Constable allegedly hid marriage, broke woman’s two engagements; mother claims daughter was trapped
stories.summary: Suman Dwivedi, mother of 24-year-old Yashasvi Dwivedi, has made serious allegations against constable Rajat, claiming he trapped her daughter in a relationship while posted at Minerva Chowki around nine years ago. She said, “Rajat would often visit their home during patrol duty and gradually developed a relationship with her daughter, who was then studying in Class 12. According to her, once the affair came to light, the family arranged her marriage, and the relationship was temporarily broken”. However, she alleged, “In 2023, Rajat again influenced Yashasvi to end her engagement with another boy and start living with him. Although Rajat was already married, he concealed this fact from my daughter and later kept her under his control without formal marriage". She also stated that the family came to know the truth after about five years, by which time the situation had already worsened. Separately, police on May 8 arrested Yashasvi Dwivedi and her associate Nisha Khan (32) from a flat in Royal City, Jhansi, in connection with an alleged betting racket. During the raid, police recovered jewellery worth ₹1.55 crore, including nine 100-gram gold biscuits, ₹18.92 lakh cash, 12 mobile phones and a laptop. Police officials said five accused, including constable Rajat, are currently absconding and efforts are on to trace them. First read, how the love story began Yashasvi Dwivedi, a resident of Chhaniyapura locality under Kotwali police station area, is the only daughter of her parents. She has a younger brother, Sudarshan, aged 11. Her father, Devendra Dwivedi, is posted as a Home Guard. Her mother, Suman Dwivedi, stated that in 2017 her husband was posted at Minerva Chowki, located around one kilometre from their residence. At the same time, constable Rajat Kumar Singh was also posted there. She alleged, “Rajat would frequently visit their home during patrol duties, often stopping under the pretext of drinking water or other reasons. According to her, Yashasvi was 16 years old at the time and studying in Class 12 when she was allegedly misled and drawn into a relationship”. Affair came to light when attending a wedding Suman said, “The family had no knowledge of the relationship initially. During this period, Yashasvi secretly attended a wedding of Rajat’s sisters in Agra, telling her family that she was going on a trip with friends”. She added that after a few days, the family came to know about the relationship and counselled their daughter before sending her to a hostel. By then, Rajat had reportedly been transferred to SOG. She further alleged, “Despite the posting change, the accused continued to exert influence and would visit the hostel to meet their daughter”. Suman added that due to the situation, the family had arranged their daughter’s marriage earlier, but Yashasvi later ended that relationship. After this, in 2023, she was again engaged to another boy, and the family hoped her future would finally settle. However, she alleged that Rajat later persuaded her daughter to break off this second engagement as well. Suman further said that she questioned her daughter repeatedly about why she was repeatedly ending engagements and whether there was any issue she was hiding. To this, Yashasvi reportedly said that she liked Rajat and would marry only him, but wanted to delay marriage for some time due to her younger brother. The mother added that when her daughter began expressing extreme emotional distress and threats of self-harm, the family refrained from exerting pressure. Eventually, she left the house and started living with Rajat, according to the allegation. The constable was married, he hid this fact Suman said, “My daughter says that Rajat touched me and I have a relationship with him. Now I will live with him only. But the reality is that he deceived her. Rajat was already married. He has two children. He trapped my daughter by claiming to be unmarried. After 5 years when he came to Jhansi with his family, my husband found out”. She added, “My daughter also asked him many times to marry, but Rajat kept making excuses every time. Till now he has not married. When we explained to our daughter, she would say no mom, now marriage is useless. I will not ruin any other boy's life. My daughter loved him, whereas Rajat has committed fraud. My daughter also says that she has not received the status of a wife till now”. 'If he loved my daughter, why did he run away?' - Suman Suman said, “My daughter has been trapped. Rajat was at the flat that day. As soon as he left, the police raided. When he was present at the flat, why did he run away? If he liked my daughter, he should not have run away”. She further said, “This is what love is. Rajat used my daughter. He built his own house, took care of his wife and children. What did he give my daughter? He only gave her food. Can't we feed her?” She added, “My daughter had completed B.Tech and was now doing M.Tech. She was very intelligent in studies. She wanted to join the police service. She had also recently appeared for the inspector's exam”. Found out when the police station called Suman said, "After the daughter's arrest, when a call came from the police station, we went to the station. There, our daughter started saying, Papa, I won't come home because I cannot live with disgrace." She further added, “The daughter has made a mistake. That's why the police arrested her. But the constable Rajat's crime is greater than the daughter's. My daughter has very good character, but the constable's character is loose. I want Rajat to get the strictest punishment”. Suman said, “My daughter has broken my trust many times, she only listened to Rajat. Therefore, I won't be able to trust my daughter as much, but if she comes home after being released from jail, I will accept her. However, I will take it in writing that if anything happens to my child. If there is any trouble in coming and going, then Rajat will be responsible for it”. Now read the story of the arrest Raid on flat, gold worth ₹1.46 cr and silver worth ₹11 lakh found SSP BB GTS Murthy stated, “Sipri Bazaar police station was conducting checking at Bihari Tiraha on Friday (May 8) morning. Information was received that online betting on IPL matches was being conducted on a large scale in flat LS9 of Royal City. Police immediately raided the flat with a team”. Police arrested Yashaswi Dwivedi (24), a resident of Chhaniyapura, and Nisha Khan (32), a resident of Shastri Nagar in Premnagar. A trolley bag was kept near the sofa there, from which a large amount of cash and jewelry were recovered. Cash and electronic devices were found including gold worth ₹1.46 cr and silver worth ₹11 lakh. The SSP said, “During interrogation, it was revealed that Yashaswi is the girlfriend of constable Rajat. Constable Rajat, along with his associate Sumit Sahu, BJP leader Ashish Upadhyay, Vishal Bhargav, Prabhat Agrawal and 3 unknown persons, runs online betting on IPL matches. All the people used to come to the flat and bet through mobile phones and laptops. BJP leader Ashish Upadhyay was leading it”. He added, “Cash and jewelry were received in exchange for running the betting operation, which Rajat had brought to the flat in a bag a few days ago. The distribution of money and jewelry was to take place after the IPL ended. Both women were also to receive a share from this. Nisha Khan is the female friend of accused Sumit. A case has been registered against all of them under BNS and Gambling Act at Sipri Bazaar”. Were preparing to flee leaving Jhansi Sources say that there was a dispute between Nisha and Yashasvi over the distribution of money. Meanwhile, the police reached the house of absconding accused Sumit while searching for him. Information about Nisha was obtained from here. When the police interrogated Nisha, she exposed Yashasvi. Nisha told the police that Yashasvi was preparing to leave Jhansi with the cash. Constable had run over retired registrar Accused constable Rajat Kumar had made headlines 12 days ago. At that time, he had run over retired Assistant Registrar Maniram Verma (70) with a THAR vehicle at Bundelkhand University. Maniram had died on the spot. He was then arrested and sent to jail. He was posted at Poonch police station. The SSP had suspended him and initiated departmental action. He had been released from jail just a few days ago. He had reported for duty on May 7. After that, his name came up in betting. The SSP dismissed constable Rajat on May 7.

stories.title: Scorpio overturns thrice after hitting pole in Noida:Car catches fire after crash; BJP district president’s nephew injured; friend dies in accident
stories.summary: In Greater Noida, a speeding Scorpio collided with an electric pole and overturned 3 times before coming to rest. One youth died in the accident, while his friend was injured. His treatment is ongoing at the hospital. The collision was so severe that the vehicle was completely mangled. The bonnet also caught fire. After the accident, the car's siren kept blaring for a long time, which attracted people from the surrounding area. The injured youth is said to be the nephew of Aligarh BJP District President Krishnapal Singh. The incident occurred on Friday night in the Knowledge Park police station area. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. First see three pictures People came out of their homes hearing the sound of the collision People present at the scene at the time of the accident said - the Scorpio was at very high speed. Suddenly the driver lost control and the car crashed straight into an electric pole. The sound of the collision was so loud that people from nearby homes and shops came out. There was chaos at the scene. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. In the footage, the Scorpio can be seen running at high speed. It was fortunate that at the time this accident occurred, the road was empty, otherwise a major accident would have happened. After the accident, the car was badly damaged. Upon receiving information, Knowledge Park police station officers reached the spot. Both the injured were taken to the hospital. In the car were Rishabh, son of Dinesh from Jattari in Aligarh, and Gurudev, nephew of BJP district president Krishnapal Singh. During treatment, Rishabh died, while Gurudev's condition remains critical. Station in-charge Sarvesh Kumar Singh said - Prima facie, the cause of the accident appears to be high speed. Investigation is being conducted based on CCTV footage and other evidence. The body has been sent for post-mortem.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Yogi lays foundation stone of international cricket stadium; PM Modi says, 'World is facing decade of crises'
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. PM Modi warns global crises may push world into poverty trap Prime Minister Narendra Modi, addressing the Indian community in The Hague, warned that the world is facing a “decade of crises” due to COVID-19, wars and the energy crisis. He said continued instability could reverse decades of progress and push millions globally into poverty. 2. Yogi lays foundation stone of international cricket stadium in Gorakhpur Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and the Union Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri laid the foundation stone of the International Cricket Stadium in Gorakhpur on Saturday. The event marked a major step toward one of the state’s ambitious sports infrastructure projects. 3. Azam Khan gets 2-year jail in hate speech case Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, who is imprisoned in Rampur Jail, has been handed another sentence. On Saturday afternoon, Rampur's MP-MLA Court sentenced Azam Khan to 2 years in a hate speech case. This hate speech case was related to the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. At that time, Azam was the SP-BSP alliance candidate from Rampur. 4. India may face drought and extreme heat Amid forecasts of below-normal rainfall in India this year, concerns are growing over the return of El Niño. stories.title: 5 family members dead in Purvanchal Expressway accident:Speeding Dzire rammed parked trailer while travelling from Bihar to Delhi
stories.summary: In Azamgarh, five people were killed on Saturday after a speeding Swift Dzire car rammed into a parked trailer on the Purvanchal Expressway. The car was reportedly travelling at around 135 kmph. All five occupants died on the spot. The vehicle was completely mangled in the crash. Police reached the spot soon after receiving information and sent all the bodies for postmortem examination. Efforts are being made to identify the deceased. The accident took place around 3 PM near milestone number 238 on the Purvanchal Expressway in the Kandharapur police station area. See 4 pictures... Among the dead are 2 girls and one woman The deceased include two men, one woman and two minor girls. Police recovered an identity card from the spot belonging to a person named Manish Srivastava. The ID carried two addresses — Faridabad (Haryana) and Siwan district (Bihar). When police reached the Faridabad address, the house was found locked. Azamgarh Police are now coordinating with Siwan police to establish the identities of the deceased. Officials said there was no survivor who could explain how the accident happened. Car removed using crane The front portion and roof of the white Swift Dzire were completely crushed in the collision. The impact was so severe that the vehicle’s structure was badly compressed. Both front seats and the interior section of the car were almost entirely destroyed. The trailer involved in the accident bore a Rajasthan registration number. A large crane was called to remove the damaged car from the highway. SP Traffic Pankaj Kumar Srivastava said that Dial 112 received information about a Swift Dzire crashing into a stationary trailer near milestone 238 on the Purvanchal Expressway. He said that immediately after the alert, teams from Kandharapur police station, CO City Azamgarh, CCTV unit, fire brigade, ambulance services, and senior officers reached the spot. All the bodies were sent to the mortuary through ambulances, and efforts are underway to contact the families of the deceased.

stories.title: Prateek Yadav’s ashes immersed in Ganga at Haridwar:Daughter floats ‘I Love Papa’ card; wife Aparna breaks down in tears
stories.summary: The ashes of SP chief Prateek Yadav were immersed in the Ganga at Haridwar on Saturday in the presence of yoga guru Baba Ramdev. During the emotional ceremony, Prateek’s younger daughter floated a handwritten “I LOVE PAPA” card into the river, leaving family members in tears. Before the immersion, priests conducted traditional rituals at the ghat. The prayers were led by MP Aditya Yadav, son of Shivpal Singh Yadav. Prateek’s wife Aparna Yadav, their daughters, along with family members including Tej Pratap Yadav and Akshay Yadav, attended the rituals. As the urn was taken for immersion, the younger daughter held it against her forehead and broke down in tears. Earlier, Aparna Yadav also became emotional while carrying the ashes at the ghat, with relatives consoling her. The family had travelled from Lucknow to Dehradun’s Jolly Grant Airport by chartered aircraft before proceeding directly to Haridwar by road. Tej Pratap Yadav was seen carrying the urn, while Akshay Yadav carried the ritual items. Aparna, dressed in a simple saree, appeared visibly grief-stricken throughout the journey. Prateek Yadav died in Lucknow on 13 May at the age of 38. His last rites were performed the following day. He was the son of late Mulayam Singh Yadav and Sadhana Gupta. Aparna Yadav is a BJP leader and currently serves as vice-chairperson of the Uttar Pradesh State Women Commission. See pictures Studied in Britain, stayed away from politics

stories.title: Mother burned alive while saving 4 children in Prayagraj:Daughters rescued by ladder; infant tossed wrapped in sheet
stories.summary: A mother lost her life trying to save her children in Prayagraj. Amidst the fierce fire and smoke, she struggled for about 30 minutes to save her three children. Amidst the rapidly spreading fire, she wrapped her one-year-old infant in a sheet and extended him from the roof towards the neighbors. The neighbors somehow reached out and safely rescued the child. After this, she also safely brought out her two daughters by placing a ladder from her roof to the neighbor's roof across the street. However, during this, she herself got trapped amidst the fire and smoke. Due to the smoke, she started suffocating, and in no time, she was engulfed by the fire and burned alive. This tragic incident occurred on May 12 during a massive fire at the house of a crockery businessman in Prayagraj. On Saturday, a video emerged showing the bravery of the mother who burned alive while saving her children. See pictures

stories.title: Azam Khan gets 2-year jail in hate speech case:SP leader had said, 'I would make officers to clean my shoes'
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, who is imprisoned in Rampur Jail, has been handed another sentence. On Saturday afternoon, Rampur's MP-MLA Court sentenced Azam Khan to 2 years in a hate speech case. This hate speech case was related to the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. At that time, Azam was the SP-BSP alliance candidate from Rampur. During the election campaign, a video of Azam emerged, in which he was saying- "Everyone stand firm, don't be afraid of collectors or officials, they are salaried employees, we are not afraid of them. I have seen many photos of Mayawati. How big officers used to take out handkerchiefs and clean her shoes. We have an alliance with them, and if Allah wills, I will make these officials clean my shoes..." At that time, Anjaneya Kumar Singh was the DM of Rampur, who is now the Commissioner of Moradabad. On his instructions, the then Tanda SDM and flying squad in-charge Ghanshyam Tripathi lodged a complaint against Azam Khan at Bhot police station. Following this, the police registered a hate speech case against him. Azam Khan was out of jail for 55 days last year. In 2022, he was sentenced to 3 years in a hate speech case, but was later acquitted in 2023. However, in the same year, he, his wife Tazeen Fatima and son Abdullah were sentenced to 7 years each in the fake birth certificate case. Following this conviction, he also lost his assembly membership. After spending around 23 months in jail, he was released on bail on 23 September 2025. But just 55 days later, he was again sentenced to 7 years in the fake PAN card case involving his son Abdullah, and both were sent back to jail. Azam and Abdullah kept making one mistake after another

stories.title: 'You should have waited till 13th-day rites':OP Rajbhar calls Akhilesh Yadav power-hungry; says, 'Join my party to become minister in Yogi govt'
stories.summary: Panchayati Raj Minister in Yogi cabinet, Om Prakash Rajbhar has retaliated against Akhilesh Yadav's statement. He wrote on Facebook on Saturday, "Your brother has passed away. I also share your grief, but you are so power-hungry that you are thinking of politics even amidst the family's 'grief'. He said- It seems you have abandoned all shame. At least wait until the thirteenth day ritual. What do you think, that you might also get a department? If interested, join Suhaspa. I will fight with CM Yogi, but I will make you minister of one department. Actually, the cabinet expansion took place in UP on May 10. Six days have passed, but the 6 new faces who took oath and two promoted ministers do not have departments to work in. Political statements have started regarding this. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav had taunted on Friday with an X post. He said, "The real reason for the delay in the distribution of ministries is simply that the 'commission-earnings' distribution is causing a clash between the double engine. Read Rajbhar's full statement Akhilesh ji, your brother has just passed away. The entire family is in distress. That is why I am also sharing your grief. I had stopped speaking and writing about your divisive politics. But you are so power-hungry that even amidst the family's 'grief', you are thinking about politics and what is happening in other people's homes. You are more concerned about this. It seems you have abandoned public decency. Just wait until the thirteenth-day ritual, then we can engage in the politics of ideas. You can say something to us, and we will tell you something... But if your departed brother is watching this behavior, what would he be thinking? Have a little consideration. As for the distribution of departments after the cabinet expansion, what do you think, will you also get a department? If you are interested, join Suhaspa, I will fight with Honorable Chief Minister Yogiji, but I will make you a minister of one department. Akhilesh, the madman, in an alien cabinet!) What Akhilesh Yadav had said, read verbatim: 21 hours ago, Akhilesh Yadav had said on Yogi's cabinet expansion: "After the names of ministers in UP, will the 'slips' for their departments also come from above now? The real reason for the delay in the distribution of ministries is simply that the 'double engine' is clashing over the distribution of 'commission-earnings'." The new ministers, appointed after a long wait, are merely sitting in the spectators' gallery, watching the ball move back and forth. The BJP's 'double engine' renders all other ministers ineffective. The people of UP have resolved that whatever ministry or department the new ministers receive, it will be thoroughly watched and monitored, so that these newly appointed ministers cannot fill their own coffers. For this, along with documentary evidence, audio-video proofs will also be collected, and the true colors of these BJP members will be exposed. Now the public itself will stop the BJP members from looting their tax money, because the corrupt BJP has already ruined all other departments meant to stop corruption. The public feels that now they can only get justice through social media and citizen journalism. The BJP government knows that this is the last time it is in power, which is why these BJP members want to amass money greedily. The aware public will now not let these BJP members succeed in their dirty schemes. Social media war between Akhilesh-Rajbhar For some time now, a social media battle has been going on between the SP chief and Yogi's minister OP Rajbhar. OP Rajbhar is openly commenting on every statement and post of Akhilesh. Regarding photos with Mamata-Stalin, he said - they will set a new record of defeat On May 7, Akhilesh Yadav met former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee and former Tamil Nadu CM MK Stalin at their private residences. Sharing pictures of the meeting on social media, he said - Mamata Didi, you fought you haven't lost.. Reacting to Akhilesh's post, OP Rajbhar said- He went to console him, saying you have only lost once, we have lost twice. Let's create a new series of losses together. When the Bengal election results were coming in, Akhilesh didn't say anything for 4 hours, now he went to talk. It seems Akhilesh will set a new record for defeat this time. Spent cartridges have gathered in SP OP Rajbhar, who arrived in Jaunpur two days ago, took a dig at Akhilesh while speaking to the media. When asked about going with Akhilesh Yadav in the 2027 assembly elections, he said, “No one wants to sit on a sinking ship. In SP, vacant cartridges have gathered. There is no leader left in the party who has the ability to win an assembly seat on their own.”

stories.title: Yogi lays foundation stone of international cricket stadium in Gorakhpur:Union minister Hardeep Singh Puri praises UP CM's tough image
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and the Union Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri laid the foundation stone of the International Cricket Stadium in Gorakhpur on Saturday. The event marked a major step toward one of the state’s ambitious sports infrastructure projects. Before the ceremony, the Union Minister offered prayers at Guru Gorakhnath temple. During the event, MP Ravi Kishan arrived in a carpool with Union Minister Kamlesh Paswan and Kushinagar MP Vijay Dubey, reflecting a notable political presence at the site. See pictures ₹393 crore dream sports project The International Cricket Stadium is being developed at an estimated cost of ₹393 crore and is considered one of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s key dream projects. Following the Chief Minister’s announcement, construction work began on December 24, 2025, on land provided by the administration in Tal Nador. Construction progress and timeline An initial installment of ₹63.39 crore has already been released for the project, and construction work is currently underway. According to the Public Works Department’s Construction Division One (Building), around 7% of the work has been completed so far. The stadium is scheduled to be completed by December 23, 2027, as per the executing agency’s timeline.

stories.title: Premanand Maharaj bursts into laughter watching Kailash Kher dance:Sings Bam Lahiri wearing peacock-feather garland; gazes at Banke Bihari
stories.summary: Sufi singer Kailash Kher reached Keli Kunj Ashram in Vrindavan on Friday morning to meet Premanand Maharaj. Kailash Kher garlanded Premanand with a peacock feather garland. He greeted him with folded hands, then sang the song Bam Lahari and danced. Hearing Kailash Kher's devotional song and watching his dance, Premanand Maharaj laughed heartily. Earlier on Thursday evening, Kailash Kher had darshan of Lord Banke Bihari. During this time, he kept gazing intently at the Lord's image. He stayed in the temple for about 30 minutes. First see 3 pictures... Famous bhajan singer Kailash Kher reached Vrindavan late Thursday evening. He stayed at a five-star hotel. After this, Kailash Kher reached Banke Bihari Temple. Kailash Kher kept gazing at the image of Lord Banke Bihari seated in Phool Bangla. Here he applied perfume on the threshold. During this, sevayat Mohit Goswami presented him with the Lord's prasadi, angavastra and prasad. Premanand Maharaj inquired about the singer's well-being On Friday morning, Kailash Kher reached Keli Kunj Ashram. The ashram's volunteers welcomed him by draping a dupatta. Premanand Maharaj asked Kailash Kher, are you well? To which the singer said - I'm great. After this, Kailash Kher took the mic and folded his hands. Then he started singing the Bam Lahari song. After listening to the song, Premanand Maharaj said - Very beautiful When Kailash Kher suddenly started dancing while singing the bhajan, Sant Premanand Maharaj started smiling. After listening to the 1 minute 30 second bhajan, Sant Premanand Maharaj praised the singer. After this, Kailash Kher said - I want to sing one more bhajan. To which Sant Premanand said - Yes. Kailash Kher sang the bhajan "5 varsh ki Meera Ladli ho, sakhiyan mein khela jaye ri, sun rana bai ri" in his own style to Sant Premanand Maharaj. After listening to this bhajan, Sant Premanand Maharaj said - "Very good voice." After this, Kailash Kher took blessings from Sant Premanand Maharaj and left from there.

stories.title: UP sizzles above 45°C, heatwave in 8 districts:Monsoon may enter via Gorakhpur by June 18; nights to stay warmer
stories.summary: Monsoon may arrive in UP around June 18. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said that the monsoon could reach Kerala around May 26. He said - "Considering the current situation, it has been estimated that the monsoon will enter Uttar Pradesh via Gorakhpur on June 18. However, this is a probable date. The exact date can only be assessed when the monsoon moves beyond Kerala." On Saturday, the weather is clear in Western and Eastern Uttar Pradesh. There is bright sunshine. The Meteorological Department has issued a heatwave alert for 8 districts including Jhansi and Lalitpur. In the last 24 hours, rain was recorded in Kanpur, Hardoi, Badaun, and Jalaun. Meanwhile, Banda remained the hottest city in the state, where the maximum temperature was recorded at 45.2 degrees Celsius. Due to storms and rain on Wednesday and Thursday, 111 people died in the state. On Friday, players of Lucknow Super Giants and Chennai Super Kings observed a two-minute silence at Lucknow's Ekana Stadium to mourn the deaths. Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said - The effect of the Western Disturbance has ended. Now the temperature will increase. It will be hot during the day as well as at night. There is a possibility of a heatwave and increasing heat. The mercury can reach up to 47 degrees. See weather pictures- Less rain will occur in UP during monsoon, know the reason Between June and September, Uttar Pradesh is also likely to receive less than normal rainfall. Dr. M. Mohapatra, Director General of the India Meteorological Department, stated that this year, conditions similar to La Nia in the Pacific Ocean are ending and showing signs of moving towards El Nio, which will cause less rainfall. This means that this year, there are indications of the Southwest Monsoon being weaker than normal. Additionally, the reduced snow cover in the Northern Hemisphere during January-March this year can also affect the monsoon. Last year, monsoon rained 10 to 15% more According to the Meteorological Department, Uttar Pradesh recorded an average rainfall of 870 to 900 mm during the 2025 monsoon season (June to September). This was about 10 to 15 percent more than the normal monsoon average. Crops damaged by storms and rain, Yogi says - Government stands with the people Crops have also suffered heavy damage due to the rain and storms on Wednesday and Thursday. Vegetable crops, especially cucumber, gherkin, and watermelon, have been most affected. CM Yogi had said on Thursday that in this hour of disaster, the government stands with the farmers and the public. Continuous monitoring is being done at the government level so that assistance can reach those in need on time. Any kind of negligence by officers in relief work will not be tolerated. How will the weather be for the next 3 days? Why is the weather fluctuating? The Meteorological Department says that the weather in the mountains of Uttarakhand is constantly changing. There is snowfall in some places and rain in others. On some days, the weather clears up with sunshine. Similar fluctuations are expected for the next few days. Its effect is visible in UP. Winds coming from the mountains have kept the weather cold. They are creating systems favorable for rain.

stories.title: House linked to Meerut blue drum murder lies abandoned:Residents fear passing through lane, owner says no buyer for 14 months
stories.summary: Our life completely changed after Saurabh’s murder. People now call our home the ‘murder house’. Our only mistake was that we rented the house to Saurabh and Muskan, thinking they were a decent family. These are the words of Ompal, a resident of Meerut whose rented house became the centre of a shocking murder case in March 2025. On March 3, 2025, Muskan, along with her boyfriend Sahil, allegedly murdered her husband Saurabh. The body was cut into pieces, placed inside a blue plastic drum and covered with cement mixture to hide the crime. Ompal said the house has remained locked for the past 14 months since the murder case came to light. The police sealed the property and kept the keys. He said the closure has caused major financial losses because the family depended on rent for household expenses. The Dainik Bhaskar team visited Ompal’s house in Indira Nagar area of Meerut and spoke to him about the incident and its impact on his life. Part-1: ‘We trusted them because they looked like a good family’ Elderly couple lived beside tenants Ompal owns a two-storey house built on a 200-square-yard plot in the Brahmpuri police station area. He lives there with his wife, while other portions were rented out to tenants. Around three years ago, he rented one portion of the house to Saurabh and Muskan for Rs 6,000 per month. Their daughter Pihu also lived with them. According to Ompal, Saurabh appeared polite and responsible, which is why the family agreed to rent out the house. He later learned that Muskan’s maternal home was nearby, which increased their trust in the couple. Rent and bills were always paid on time Ompal said Saurabh later moved to London for work while Muskan continued living in the house with their daughter. Every month, Saurabh sent money online and Muskan paid the rent in cash. Electricity bills were also cleared regularly. He said the couple never created any problems for the landlords and their daughter’s presence made the elderly couple feel comfortable. ‘Our only son also died’ Ompal said he originally belonged to Haryana and earlier ran a cloth business in Meerut. After his only son died within two years of marriage, he shut down the business and began depending on rent for survival. He said the rent from tenants helped him and his wife manage daily expenses. ‘Sahil used to visit the house’ When asked about Sahil, Ompal said he had seen him visiting Muskan several times. Initially, Sahil came to deliver online parcels, but later started entering the house as well. Ompal also claimed that Muskan mostly stayed indoors and frequently ordered food online instead of cooking at home. ‘I unknowingly took her to buy medicines’ Ompal said Muskan once asked him to take her to a medical store on his scooter because she was unwell and unable to go alone. He said he waited outside while Muskan purchased medicines using a prescription. He claimed he neither checked the prescription nor knew what medicines she bought. Couple had gone to village during murder Ompal said Saurabh had returned from London to Meerut around March 1, 2025, after nearly two years abroad. Around the same time, he and his wife went to their village for personal work. When they returned on March 15, they found the rented portion locked. Muskan later told them that she, Saurabh and their daughter had gone out sightseeing. Ompal said they had no idea that Saurabh’s body was allegedly hidden inside a drum kept in the house. Part-2: ‘We realised later the murder happened inside our house’ ‘We were shocked when police arrived’ Ompal recalled that Muskan returned alone on March 17. When asked about Saurabh, she reportedly said he would arrive later. Later that afternoon, police vehicles and crowds gathered outside the house. Ompal said he initially believed some incident had happened nearby, but soon realised the crime had taken place inside his own property. He said the family was shocked and struggled to believe that such a crime had happened in their house. Part-3: ‘We are suffering for someone else’s crime’ ‘People treat us like criminals’ Speaking emotionally, Ompal said he and his wife are facing social humiliation despite having no role in the crime. “If we had even the slightest idea about such intentions, we would never have kept them as tenants,” he said. He added that people now look at them with suspicion and behave as if they were responsible for the murder. Health worsened after the case Ompal said the stress from the case badly affected his health. He claimed to have lost nearly 25 kg in one year and developed problems related to blood pressure, diabetes and the heart. He also said his eyesight deteriorated and even surgery did not help because of continuous stress. Relatives and neighbours stopped visiting According to Ompal, relatives, neighbours and friends gradually distanced themselves after the murder case. He said people in the locality stare at them and avoid conversations. Even relatives hesitate to visit the house because of fear linked to the incident. Unable to sell the property Ompal said the house has remained sealed for more than a year and he has not been allowed to enter it. The family has received no rent during this period, though electricity bills continue to arrive. He said several property dealers were approached to sell the house, but no buyer showed interest because of the murder case. Wants to return to village Ompal said he now wants the legal process to finish so the house can be released. He plans to sell the property and return to his village in Haryana with his wife. “We only want peace for the remaining years of our life,” he said quietly.

stories.title: UP cabinet tussle:Bhupendra and Keshav eye PWD; AK Sharma seeks powerful ministry in exchange for Energy
stories.summary: Six days after the Uttar Pradesh cabinet expansion on May 10, the six newly inducted ministers and two promoted ministers are still waiting for their departments. The delay has now triggered political sparring between the BJP and the Samajwadi Party. Akhilesh Yadav targets BJP over delay Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav took a jibe at the BJP government on Friday through a post on X. He claimed the delay was due to a clash between the “double-engine governments” over the sharing of “commission earnings”. The newly appointed ministers had taken oath in the presence of Governor Anandiben Patel and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Tug-of-war over key ministries According to government sources, the main deadlock is over the allocation of important portfolios to newly inducted cabinet ministers Bhupendra Chaudhary and Manoj Pandey. Supporters of both leaders are pushing for major departments in line with their political stature. The reshuffle is expected to affect at least five ministers, including the Chief Minister. However, ministers from alliance parties are unlikely to lose their departments, limiting the government’s options. Currently, Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya and Urban Development Minister AK Sharma hold multiple departments, making them central to the reshuffle discussions. PWD and Energy departments at centre of discussions Sources said there is pressure from the BJP’s central leadership to give Keshav Prasad Maurya an important ministry. His supporters are demanding the Public Works Department (PWD), which he handled during the government’s first term. At present, the PWD department is with the Chief Minister after previously being handled by Jitin Prasada. Supporters of Bhupendra Chaudhary are also lobbying for the same department, citing his seniority and former role as BJP state president. The Energy Department has also become a key issue. The portfolio is currently with AK Sharma, who is considered close to the party’s central leadership. Sources said the Chief Minister wants to hand the department to Manoj Pandey, but that would require giving AK Sharma another influential ministry. Rural Development is being considered as another possible option for Manoj Pandey, but that may depend on whether Keshav Prasad Maurya gets the PWD department. Independent charge ministers also awaiting departments Ajit Singh Pal and Somendra Tomar, who were promoted to Ministers of State (Independent Charge), are also waiting for departments. Sources said one of them may get the Mining Department while the other could be assigned the Food Processing Ministry. Offices allotted, portfolios still pending Even though departments have not been assigned, office rooms have already been allotted to the newly inducted ministers. Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary has been given a room in Vidhan Bhavan, while Manoj Pandey and other ministers have received office space in Bapu Bhavan. Yogi meets Amit Shah and BJP chief in Delhi After the cabinet expansion, CM Yogi Adityanath held a meeting with ministers at his residence and later travelled to Delhi on Thursday. There, he met Union Home Minister Amit Shah and BJP national president Nitin Naveen. Sources said the meetings focused on the distribution of portfolios. There were expectations that the departments would be allocated on Friday, but the Chief Minister instead travelled to Maharajganj and Gorakhpur for official programmes. BJP says there is no issue Responding to the opposition’s criticism, BJP spokesperson Rakesh Tripathi said there was no deadlock over the allocation of ministries. He said the Chief Minister was out of the capital and portfolio distribution is entirely his prerogative.

stories.title: ‘If religion is attacked, Yogi will not remain silent’:UP CM recalls grand Ram Temple construction in Ayodhya
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said that anyone attempting to attack religion would receive a “strong response,” asserting that his government would not remain silent in such situations. Addressing a gathering on Monday, at the idol installation ceremony at Shri Shiv Gorakhnath Ashram in Bhagwanpur Nangal village of Baghpat district, the Chief Minister referred to the construction of the Ram Temple in Ayodhya and said, “A grand Ram Temple was built in Ayodhya. Could anyone stop it? No one could.” He also took an apparent swipe at political opponents, saying some people secretly took COVID-19 vaccines and visited the Sangam for a holy dip but publicly denied doing so. Participated in religious ceremony at Gorakhnath Ashram The Chief Minister reached the Shri Shiv Gorakhnath Ashram on Monday, where he offered prayers and attended the idol consecration programme. During his address, Yogi Adityanath said the day was significant because it marked the anniversary of the re-consecration of the Somnath Temple. “Today, the Prime Minister himself was present at the Somnath Swabhiman celebration at the temple. I also had the privilege of being associated with this occasion at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple,” he said. Recalled Pokhran nuclear tests The Chief Minister also referred to India’s nuclear tests conducted on May 11, 1998, under former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. “On this very day, Atalji conducted three nuclear tests in Pokhran under Operation Shakti. After that, India emerged as an important nuclear power, and the world was left astonished by India’s success,” he said. Yogi Adityanath added that Sanatan Dharma had never tried to forcibly rule or enslave others. “History is witness that Sanatan Dharma never forcibly occupied anyone’s land or enslaved people. That is why our country cannot tolerate aggression against itself,” he said. ‘Baghpat is a sacred land linked to Mahabharata’ The Chief Minister described Baghpat as a historically and spiritually significant place linked to the Mahabharata. He said Baghpat was among the five villages that Lord Krishna had sought from the Kauravas for the Pandavas. “Today Baghpat has become a district. When I visited here four years ago, it was a small place. I thank those who transformed it into a pilgrimage centre,” he said. He also praised Rashtriya Lok Dal leader Jayant Chaudhary and former Mumbai Police Commissioner Satyapal Singh, saying development and heritage were progressing together in the region. ‘Religion protects those who protect it’ Quoting the Sanskrit phrase “Dharmo Rakshati Rakshitah,” Yogi Adityanath said people must protect religion, as religion in turn protects society. “We should never knowingly or unknowingly harm the nation or religion. Damage to religion cannot be compensated,” he said. Claims improvement in jobs and law order The Chief Minister said recruitment opportunities had increased significantly in Baghpat and surrounding districts in recent years. “Earlier, recruitments did not take place here. Today, thousands of youths are getting jobs without discrimination, including youths from Baghpat, Muzaffarnagar, and Saharanpur,” he said. He also claimed that women and traders now feel safer in Uttar Pradesh and that investments were increasing in the state. Gorakhnath Ashram has 400-year-old legacy According to local accounts, the Shri Shiv Gorakhnath Ashram has a history of nearly 400 years. It is believed that saints Baba Chhotenath and Baba Lichhinath attained samadhi at the site after years of penance. Spread across nearly 23 bighas of land, the ashram houses several temples dedicated to Lord Shiva, Hanuman, Bhairav, Shani Dev, Navnath saints, and Guru Gorakhnath. The samadhi sites of Baba Chhotenath and Baba Lichhinath are considered spiritually significant by devotees. The ashram continues to serve as a centre for yoga, meditation, devotional singing, and Nath sect traditions. In 2022, the Uttar Pradesh Tourism Department carried out beautification work at the ashram worth Rs 6.16 crore. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had also visited the site in 2023.

stories.title: Bulldozer action on 125-year-old 'Musafirkhana' in Kashi:25 houses demolished in Daalmandi road-widening project
stories.summary: A 125-year-old 'Musafirkhana' building in Varanasi’s Daalmandi area was partially demolished on Monday as part of an ongoing road-widening project. Workers demolished the boundary wall built over the structure, while heavy police deployment remained in place to maintain law and order. Around 300 police personnel, along with paramilitary forces, were deployed in the area during the operation. Authorities also monitored the entire locality through drone surveillance. ‘Musafirkhana’ among 45 buildings marked for demolition The demolition is part of the Daalmandi Road Project, under which the existing road is being widened. A total of 45 buildings, including the Musafirkhana, fall within the project zone. The 'Musafirkhana', managed by the Waqf Board, was traditionally used as a lodging facility for travellers and also hosted wedding functions. Officials said that within the last three days, 25 houses have already been demolished using three JCB machines and around 50 labourers. The Waqf Board had been given 12 days to vacate and prepare for demolition. See 3 pictures Daalmandi has historical link to Sanjay Dutt’s family The Daalmandi area also has a connection to Bollywood actor Sanjay Dutt’s family. His grandmother, Jaddanbai, is believed to have lived in the locality. Heavy security deployment during demolition A joint team of Public Works Department (PWD) and Municipal Corporation officials reached the site on Monday morning along with police and paramilitary personnel. The area was barricaded from all sides to prevent any untoward incident during the demolition drive. PWD officials said the target is to demolish all 45 identified structures, including 20 buildings that had already been declared unsafe by the Municipal Corporation. Officials had earlier carried out demolition of 20 houses on May 9 and five more houses on May 10. ACP says, ‘Action will continue’ Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Atul Anjan Tripathi said action was being taken against dilapidated buildings and properties registered under the PWD acquisition process. “The operation will continue continuously. Adequate security force has been deployed because the Nai Sadak and Chowk areas are highly crowded zones,” he said. 'Musafirkhana' was more than a century old PWD Executive Engineer K.K. Singh said the Musafirkhana building was approximately 125 years old and had undergone repairs and modifications over time. “At present, the building was being managed by the Waqf Board and was used for lodging and wedding-related events,” Singh said. He added that a meeting had earlier been held between the district administration and the Waqf Board, during which the board requested 12 days’ time before the demolition. After the deadline ended, the demolition was carried out without resistance. 60 houses already demolished earlier For the Daalmandi road-widening project, authorities have identified a total of 187 properties, including 181 houses and six mosques. PWD first began demolition work in the area on October 29, 2025. So far, 60 houses have already been demolished, while 121 houses and six mosques are still remaining. Officials said the mosques would be demolished at the final stage of the project. What Is the Daalmandi project? The Daalmandi lane in Varanasi is being redeveloped as a model road project. Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone for the project during his 51st visit to Kashi. The Uttar Pradesh government has allocated Rs 215.88 crore for the project. Out of this, nearly Rs 191 crore will be paid as compensation to owners of 181 buildings and six mosques. 650-metre road to be expanded to 60 feet The Daalmandi stretch from Nai Sadak to Chowk Police Station is around 650 metres long. The proposal to widen the road to 17.5 metres (around 60 feet) has already been approved. The state government approved a budget of Rs 215 crore during the final day of the 2024-25 financial year, and Rs 2 crore has already been released. PWD teams conducted measurements of all 181 houses to determine how much of each property would fall under the widening project. Registry and compensation procedures have already begun. So far, registry formalities for 46 houses have been completed, and demolition work is being carried out gradually. Underground utilities planned under redevelopment According to PWD officials, the widened road will include a 30-foot-wide carriageway along with 15-foot-wide footpaths on both sides. Electricity lines, sewer systems, and water pipelines will be shifted underground as part of the redevelopment. Authorities also plan to remove the overhead network of hanging wires from the area.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:SP may reduce Muslim candidates before 2027 polls; Rahul attacks PM over West Asia crisis
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day- 1. Rahul attacks PM over West Asia crisis Congress Leader Rahul Gandhi claims the Prime Minister is no longer capable of running the country amid growing diplomatic pressure. 2. Akhilesh recasts SP’s image before 2027 polls, may field less Muslim candidates Samajwadi Party chief increases religious outreach and may reduce Muslim candidates to broaden support beyond traditional MY voters in Uttar Pradesh. 3. ‘Sanatan cannot be defeated’, says Yogi in Kashi Uttar Pradesh CM says invaders disappeared with time while India’s spiritual heritage survived centuries of attacks and destruction. 4. Gold prices fall sharply after PM’s appeal Gold dropped by ₹801 per 10 grams while silver also declined after PM Modi urged people to avoid panic buying amid uncertainty. 5. UP man arrested in Suvendu PA murder case Ballia resident Raj Singh, accused of being one of the shooters, was held from Ayodhya; family claims he has been falsely implicated. 6. Bihar man shot dead on Jammu-Tawi Express near Varanasi Victim was allegedly murdered inside the train and the body thrown onto railway tracks between Mughalsarai and Varanasi stations on Monday. 7. Iran FM likely to visit India for BRICS meet Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi may attend the BRICS Foreign Ministers’ Meeting scheduled in New Delhi on 14–15 May. 8. LPG subsidy may end for high-income consumers Oil companies begin nationwide scrutiny as households earning above ₹10 lakh annually could lose gas subsidy benefits under revised norms. 9. Retired Army man turns psycho killer in UP A suspected psychopathic killer has been arrested in Chandauli. The accused, believed to be around 45 years old, is a retired Army personnel. Police said he allegedly carried out three murders within 26 and a half hours. 10. Congress may soon announce Kerala CM face KC Venugopal has emerged as Rahul Gandhi’s preferred choice after a key meeting in Delhi, with the party expected to decide shortly.

stories.title: Vinesh Phogat says she's eligible to compete despite WFI ban:Wrestler says she will respond to federation's notice within 14 days
stories.summary: Wrestler Vinesh Phogat has responded to the show-cause notice from the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI), which barred her from competing in domestic tournaments until June 26. On Monday, Vinesh posted on social media saying that she had already received permission to play on 1 January. She claimed that the WFI had misunderstood her leave. She also said that she is eligible to participate in the Open Ranking Tournament being held in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh and has completed her registration for the same. The star wrestler also said did not violate doping rules and had already informed the officials about her non-participation in the tests. On 9 May, WFI had issued a show-cause notice to Vinesh on charges of indiscipline and violation of anti-doping rules. In the 15-page notice, WFI had written that Vinesh did not give six months' notice for her return from retirement. Therefore, she will not be able to play domestic competitions until 26 June. ‘WFI misunderstood the timelines’ In a note on social media, the 31-year-old said that the WFI misunderstood the timelines of my sabbatical from the sport and subsequent return to training and competitions. "I have been deemed eligible to return to official training and competition on January 1, 2026. I have official confirmation from the International Testing Agency (ITA)," a part of her note read. Vinesh also said that she would participate in the Senior Open Ranking Tournament being held in Gonda from 10 May to 12 May, 2026. She said she has registered her name for this and will make her comeback from retirement in this. Vinesh also opened up about the allegations of anti-doping rule violations that the WFI had slammed on her a few days ago in their notice. "With respect to the whereabouts failure from September 2024 and the Missed Test from December 2025, I confirm that I have co-operated with the relevant result management authorities promptly, and that both events do not amount to anti-doping rule violations per the National Anti-Doping Rules, 2021 or the WADA Code, 2021. ‘Will respond within 14 days’ Vinesh also addressed the topic of her participating in different weight categories at the 2024 selection trials in Patiala, stating that the ad-hoc committee running the WFI at that time was well-aware of the same and did not stop her from doing so. She said that she will prove her point and was looking forward to playing for India at the 2026 Asian Games and other international events. : Brijbhushan Singh's entry in wrestling, Vinesh Phogat out:War of words between wrestler and WFI former president intensifies| Video Official statement on Vinesh Phogat by WFI After the statement by Olympic wrestler Vinesh Phogat, Wrestling Federetion of India (WFI) shared an official response to Phogat. The organisation stated, " Vinesh Phogat was provided full security from the moment she arrived. As witnessed by everyone present, she met the officials and was informed about her ineligibility to participate, as per the rules and procedures in place. She freely interacted with the media and was not stopped or interrupted anywhere. Following this, she left the venue peacefully." “The Wrestling Federation of India treats every player equally, and player welfare and security remain our highest priorities. From her arrival in Gonda to her departure from the venue, complete security and support were extended to her at every step,” WFI added further. Why did WFI send notice to Vinesh Phogat? Did not give dope test on 18 December 2025 The International Testing Agency (ITA) had called wrestler Vinesh for a dope test in Bengaluru on 18 December, 2025, but she was not available at that time. Vinesh responded on 19 January, 2026, stating that she is a Congress MLA from Julana in Haryana. On 18 December, 2025, she was traveling from Bengaluru to Chandigarh to attend the winter session of the assembly. She also cited her new family responsibilities and the recent birth of her child. Due to her busy schedule, she was unable to update her location. Retirement at Paris Olympics, then talked about playing again Vinesh Phogat played her last wrestling match at the Paris Olympics in 2024. Vinesh played 3 matches in the 50 kg weight category on August 6, 2024, all on the same day. She defeated the Cuban wrestler in the semi-finals. Before playing the final, her weight was checked and found to be 100 grams over. She was subsequently disqualified. Vinesh Phogat announced her retirement from wrestling on 8 August, 2024. On 12 December 2025, Vinesh announced her return from retirement, stating that she wants to participate in the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

stories.title: Ballia’s Raj Singh arrested in Suvendu's PA murder case:Contested councillor elections; mother claims he is being framed
stories.summary: A suspected shooter from Uttar Pradesh has been arrested in connection with the murder of Chandranath Rath, personal assistant to Suvendu Adhikari. The accused, arrested from Ayodhya, is a resident of Ballia. In addition, West Bengal Police arrested two other suspected shooters, Mayank Raj Mishra and Vicky Maurya, from Buxar. Following the arrest, several details about the accused Raj Singh emerged. He had previously contested a council election. A poster linked to him also surfaced, in which he identified himself as the State General Secretary of the All India Kshatriya Mahasabha. His Facebook profile contains photographs with Minister Dayashankar Singh and a reel featuring former MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh. See 3 pictures- Raj’s mother claims SOG picked up her son Raj’s mother arrived at Ballia District Court on Monday afternoon and alleged that the Special Operations Group (SOG) had detained her son unlawfully. Crying before the media, she said, “On April 7, I travelled to Lucknow with my son for an MLC’s wedding. Raj, driver Om Prakash Singh, Raj’s friend Monu Singh and another person were with me. I stayed at a guesthouse near the wedding venue while the others attended the function.” She said the group returned after midnight and slept there. The next morning, they travelled to Kichhauchha Sharif in Ambedkar Nagar to offer prayers at Baba Makhdoom Ashraf shrine before heading to Ayodhya for darshan at Ram Lalla temple. ‘I met my son in the morning, then Bengal police took him away’ Jamwanti Singh claimed that while returning from Ayodhya, the SOG stopped their vehicle near a roadside dhaba. “They detained all of us, including the children. We were kept overnight at the women’s police station, while the others were held separately. The next morning I was allowed to meet Raj briefly, after which Bengal Police took him away on a flight. I do not know what happened afterwards,” she alleged. She added that Raj had also served as General Secretary of the Kshatriya Mahasabha and questioned why he was being implicated in the case. Lawyer alleges illegal arrest Raj Singh’s lawyer, Harivant Singh, addressed a press conference at the Ballia District Court premises on Monday. He claimed the arrest was illegal as no transit remand had been obtained. According to the lawyer, Raj was effectively abducted. Harivant Singh said CCTV footage showed Raj at his home on April 4, 5 and 6. “According to the information available to us, he has no connection with the Kolkata incident. Yet he has been linked to the murder case of the Chief Minister’s PA,” he said. The lawyer added that petitions were being submitted to the DIG, IG, DGP and the Governor of West Bengal, demanding an impartial investigation. He said, “No one can be detained and flown to another state without proper legal procedure.” Police suspect involvement of 8 people Investigating agencies suspect that at least eight people were involved in planning and carrying out the murder. According to preliminary findings, the accused conducted reconnaissance for several days before the attack. Investigators found that the attackers’ vehicle crossed Bali Toll Plaza shortly before the murder. A toll payment made via UPI helped police identify one suspect through the linked mobile number, eventually leading investigators to the remaining accused. Police are now matching CCTV footage from the toll plaza with images of the suspects and vehicles used in the crime. Officials said the accused had adopted multiple methods to conceal their identities and movements. Contract killers suspected, vehicles seized West Bengal Police suspect the murder may have been carried out by contract killers. Police said the nature of the operation suggested careful planning and the involvement of professional shooters. Investigators seized a car believed to have chased Rath’s Scorpio before the attack. The vehicle carried a fake registration number, while its chassis and engine numbers had been erased. Two motorcycles were also reportedly used in the attack. One bike was recovered near a tea stall around 4 km from the crime scene and was also found to have a fake registration number. The second motorcycle is yet to be traced. Chandranath had been associated with Suvendu since TMC days Before entering politics, Chandranath Rath had served in the Air Force. After taking voluntary retirement, he worked in the corporate sector for some time before joining political activities. He had been associated with Suvendu Adhikari since the latter’s days in the All India Trinamool Congress. Chandranath formally became part of Suvendu’s official team in 2019, when Suvendu was a minister in the government led by Mamata Banerjee. He was also involved in managing Suvendu’s election campaign in Bhabanipur, the constituency where Suvendu later defeated Mamata Banerjee by around 15,000 votes. Chandranath’s family also shifted from TMC to BJP Like Suvendu Adhikari, Chandranath’s family too was earlier associated with the Trinamool Congress. His mother, Hashi Rath, had held a post in the local panchayat body in Purba Medinipur during TMC rule. She joined the Bharatiya Janata Party along with Suvendu in 2020. Those close to Chandranath described him as calm and low-profile. He studied at Rahara Ramakrishna Mission and generally stayed away from public attention despite his long association with Suvendu. 90-minute timeline of the murder Police stated that such sophisticated weapons are not usually used by ordinary criminals, and the execution style pointed towards the involvement of professional shooters.

stories.title: No gas subsidy for income above ₹10 lakh:Supply resumes in Gorakhpur with 30% reduction from Motihari plant
stories.summary: Oil companies begin fresh subsidy scrutiny nationwide: LPG consumers earning above Rs 10 lakh may soon lose subsidy support Consumers already struggling to secure cooking gas cylinders are now facing another concern. After the confusion surrounding the mandatory Delivery Authentication Code (DAC) system, oil companies have begun tightening rules related to LPG subsidy eligibility. Families with an annual income of Rs 10 lakh or more may soon lose subsidy benefits on domestic cooking gas cylinders. The move is part of a fresh verification exercise being carried out using income tax records. Messages sent after income verification Oil companies have started identifying consumers whose declared family income crosses the prescribed limit. Consumers are receiving messages on their registered mobile numbers informing them that their subsidy may be discontinued. The message states that if they disagree with the decision, they must either: Contact the toll-free helpline 1800-2333-555 within seven days Register a complaint on the concerned oil company’s online portal Officials say subsidy benefits could be automatically stopped if no response is received within the stipulated period. What the notice to consumers says The message sent by oil companies clearly mentions that, according to income tax records, the taxable income of either the consumer or a family member exceeds Rs 10 lakh annually. As a result, the household may no longer remain eligible for subsidised LPG cylinders. Consumers have been given a seven-day window to raise objections or seek clarification. Existing subsidy structure remains limited At present, consumers in the state receive a subsidy of nearly Rs 59.05 on every 14.2-kg domestic LPG cylinder. Key details of the current subsidy system include: The subsidy structure has remained in place for several years. Supply disruptions continue across districts Even as subsidy rules tighten, the supply situation remains under pressure in eastern Uttar Pradesh. Cooking gas cylinders are now being supplied to Uttar Pradesh from the bottling plant in Motihari, Bihar. However, agencies say supply is still nearly 30 per cent lower than earlier levels. This has continued to create difficulties for both distributors and consumers. Some pressure has eased at the Indian Oil bottling plant in GIDA, Gorakhpur after supply resumed from Motihari. To manage demand, cylinders are also being dispatched to Basti district from the Lucknow bottling plant. Crisis persists despite partial restoration More than 75 gas agencies in Deoria, Kushinagar and Maharajganj districts earlier depended heavily on regular supply from the Motihari plant. Last month, supply to Uttar Pradesh agencies was abruptly halted, triggering a sharp cooking gas shortage across several districts. Consumers were forced to wait longer for cylinder deliveries, while agencies struggled to manage demand. Though supply has now resumed, the reduced allocation means relief remains limited. For consumers already dealing with delayed deliveries and stricter subsidy checks, the LPG crisis is far from over.
