stories.title: 'Sanatan cannot be defeated', says CM Yogi:Claims India’s spiritual heritage endured while invaders faded away over time
stories.summary: Yogi Adityanath said in Kashi on Monday, ‘Those who tried to erase Sanatan have themselves turned to dust today. No one even remembers invaders such as Muhammad Ghori and Aurangzeb. Both Somnath and Kashi send a message from history that Sanatan culture may be attacked, but it can never be defeated. Destruction is temporary, while creation is eternal.’ Earlier, Anandiben Patel and the Chief Minister offered prayers at Shri Kashi Vishwanath Dham. They chanted ‘Om’ within the temple complex. The CM presented the Governor with a stole and a Rudraksha rosary. Both leaders also watched the live telecast of Narendra Modi performing ‘Jalabhishek’ at the Somnath Temple in Gujarat. The occasion marked 75 years since the reconstruction of the Somnath Temple. On May 11, 1951, the newly rebuilt temple was consecrated in independent India. The Somnath Amrit Mahotsav is being celebrated to commemorate the occasion. A programme was also organised in Kashi, where male and female students performed conch-blowing and damru recitals. Women who arrived from Gujarat raised slogans in support of PM Modi. See pictures- CM Yogi’s 5 key remarks 1. ‘Aurangzeb demolished the Vishwanath Temple’ The Chief Minister said that from Muhammad Ghori to the Mughals, several foreign invaders attempted to destroy India’s spiritual and cultural identity. He said Aurangzeb demolished the ancient temple of Baba Vishwanath and built what he described as “a structure of slavery” in its place. However, he added that they could not break the soul of India. According to the CM, Sanatan does not merely exist within temple walls, but in India’s collective consciousness. He said India’s spiritual philosophy regards the soul as immortal and eternal, which forms the foundation of the country’s cultural heritage. 2. ‘Kashi Vishwanath and Somnath are symbols of India’s pride’ Yogi said both Kashi Vishwanath Dham and Somnath Temple are symbols of India’s pride. He said the divine and grand form of Kashi Vishwanath Dham is now visible in Kashi, while Somnath Temple is once again reflecting India’s glory with renewed radiance. The CM also alleged that even today there are forces that do not wish to see India’s spiritual and cultural centres progress. Referring to opposition faced during the reconstruction efforts, he said some groups had objected to the re-consecration ceremony of Somnath Temple and had similarly attempted to obstruct the construction of the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. 3. ‘Invaders tried to destroy Somnath’s glory’ The Chief Minister said that around 1,000 years ago, foreign invaders including Mahmud of Ghazni attacked the Somnath Temple 17 times in an attempt to destroy its glory. He said the invaders believed that by destroying idols and looting the temple’s wealth, they could permanently extinguish India’s spirit. According to him, such attacks were not limited to Somnath, but targeted thousands of religious sites across the country, including Kashi Vishwanath Dham. 4. ‘Earlier governments lacked commitment towards sanatan traditions’ CM Yogi said that after independence, India had an opportunity to strongly promote its Sanatan traditions and cultural heritage, but at the time there was no ideological commitment towards India’s civilisational identity and Sanatan values. He said that under PM Modi’s leadership, the country has received a new direction. As a result, traditions and values that foreign invaders attempted to destroy nearly a thousand years ago are now being restored with dignity and respect. He described the ongoing celebrations marking 75 years of Somnath Temple’s re-establishment as an example of this transformation. 5. ‘India’s temples symbolise eternity’ The CM said that despite opposition from the government of that era, India’s first President, Rajendra Prasad, visited Gujarat for the Somnath ceremony. Referring to Rajendra Prasad’s remarks, Yogi said physical structures may be damaged temporarily, but invaders failed to understand that the soul of India is timeless and immortal. He concluded by saying that India’s temples stand as enduring symbols of that eternity.

stories.title: Storm, rain alert in UP from tomorrow:Hail likely, Prayagraj remains hottest at 39.6°C
stories.summary: The spell of storms and rain in UP has been paused for a week. Monday morning, the weather in Eastern UP is clear. Bright sunshine has emerged. Clouds have covered Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, and Shamli in Western UP. The weather in the Bundelkhand districts is normal. There is no storm-rain alert anywhere in the entire state on Monday. From tomorrow, that is Tuesday, the weather is expected to deteriorate again. According to the Meteorological Department, a new western disturbance is becoming active. Its effect will start from May 12. During this time, there may be storms and rain. Hail may also fall. Winds will also blow at a speed of 30 to 40. Due to no rain, there has been a rapid increase in temperature. On Sunday, the day temperature reached 40°C. Prayagraj remained the hottest city. Here, the mercury was recorded at 39.6°C. Lucknow weather scientist Atul Kumar Singh said- Due to the activation of western disturbance, the weather will deteriorate between May 12 and 15. There will be rain with strong winds. The temperature will see a slight drop due to the rain. But after this, an increase of 6 to 8 °C in temperature can be recorded. This means the mercury in most cities will cross 45 °C. See pictures- Why is there fluctuation in the weather? The Meteorological Department says that the weather in the mountains of Uttarakhand is continuously changing. There is snowfall in some places and rain in others. On some days, the weather is clearing up with sunshine. Such fluctuations are expected for the next few days. Its effect is visible in UP. The winds coming from the mountains are keeping the weather cold. They are creating systems favorable for rain. What will the weather be like for the next 3 days? Forecast of less rainfall in monsoon this year Private weather agency Skymet Weather has released the forecast for this year's monsoon. According to this, monsoon rainfall may be 6% less than normal. The normal average rainfall in the country during the 4 months of monsoon from June to September is 868.6 mm. Less than normal monsoon means that rainfall will be between 90% to 95%. The agency has predicted 94% rainfall. There will be normal rainfall in June, but the decline will start from July, and the monsoon will weaken in August and September. Especially in August-September, there are indications of a greater rainfall deficit. Question- What should be done to avoid heatstroke? Answer- In summer, just avoiding the sun is not enough, but adopting the right habits is equally important. A little caution can prevent a serious problem like heatstroke. There will be less rainfall during monsoon in UP too, know the reason Between June and September, Uttar Pradesh is also expected to receive below-normal rainfall. Dr. M Mahapatra, Director General of the Meteorological Department, stated that this year there are signs of La Niña-like conditions ending in the Pacific Ocean and moving towards El Niño, which will cause reduced rainfall. This means there are indications that the southwest monsoon will be weaker than normal this year. Additionally, the reduced snow formation in the Northern Hemisphere during January-March this year may also affect the monsoon. Know about El Niño and La Niña

stories.title: Retired Army man turns psycho killer in UP:3 murders in 26 hours; 2 youths shot on moving trains, woman killed in hospital
stories.summary: A suspected psychopathic killer has been arrested in Chandauli. The accused, believed to be around 45 years old, is a retired Army personnel. He allegedly carried out three murders within 26 and a half hours. In all three cases, the victims were shot in the temple at close range, leaving them with virtually no chance of survival. The first killing took place around 7 am on Sunday aboard the DDU–Tadighat passenger train, where a young man was shot dead. The second occurred at about 2 am on Sunday near Mughalsarai Railway Station, inside the Jammu Tawi Express train. The third murder was reported at around 8:30 am on Monday in Chandauli, where the accused allegedly entered a private hospital and shot a woman lying on a bed by pressing a pistol against her temple. The three crime scenes were located within a radius of nearly 20 to 25 kilometres. Police officials identified the accused as Gurpreet Singh alias Virendra, a resident of Amritsar. Investigators believe he was responsible for all three murders. During the investigation, police concluded that the accused fits the profile of a psychopathic serial killer. After the hospital shooting, he was apprehended while attempting to flee. Police recovered two pistols from his possession, one legally registered in his name and another allegedly an illegal firearm. Incident details Accused also tried to shoot the staff Dr. Sunil Kumar Gautam, director of Jeevak Hospital, said that this morning, a person with his face covered came to the hospital on the pretext of getting treatment. During this, the staff nurse noticed his suspicious movements and sent a ward boy. Meanwhile, the accused entered the ward of admitted patients and shot a woman there. The accused also tried to shoot the staff, but people managed to save their lives by hiding under the beds. After this, the accused fled the hospital, brandishing a weapon. However, villagers chased and caught him and handed him over to the police. SP Akash Patel said- Apart from the weapon, 10 thousand rupees in cash have been recovered from the accused. Currently, the identity of the accused has not been ascertained. He is being interrogated. The case will be revealed soon.

stories.title: Bihar man shot dead on Jammu-Tawi Express:Body dumped on tracks between Mughalsarai Varanasi railway stations
stories.summary: A 42-year-old man from Bihar’s Gaya district was shot dead inside a moving train in Uttar Pradesh’s Varanasi district in the early hours of Monday. The victim, identified as Dinesh Shah, was travelling with his wife aboard the Kolkata-Jammu Tavi Express when gunmen opened fire at close range. Police said the attackers shot Shah in the head moments after he stepped out of the toilet around 2 am. The incident triggered panic inside the coach as terrified passengers rushed out after hearing the gunshot. Attackers escape as train slows down The murder took place nearly 3 km before Mughalsarai railway station near Block Hut-B. Officials said the train had slowed down in the section, allowing the attackers to jump off and flee before railway police could reach the spot. Passengers immediately alerted the Railway Protection Force and Government Railway Police. By 2:42 am, the train reached Varanasi Junction, where Shah’s body was taken off the coach for investigation and postmortem procedures. Family travelling to pilgrimage town Dinesh Shah, a resident of Pipariya village in Bihar’s Gaya district, was travelling to Naimisharanya in Sitapur with family members. Travel details: According to police, Shah’s wife rushed to the spot after hearing the gunshot and found him lying in a pool of blood inside the coach passage. Cash and jewellery found untouched Investigators said robbery may not have been the immediate motive behind the killing. Police recovered: A police team continued travelling with the train to question passengers and gather clues about the attackers. Another team has been sent to Shah’s village in Bihar to speak with relatives and examine possible personal angles behind the murder. Similar train murder reported a day earlier The incident comes barely a day after another passenger was shot dead aboard a train in the same region. According to police, a man identified as Mangru from Ghazipur was murdered on Sunday morning while travelling in a passenger train from Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Junction towards Dildarnagar and Tarighat. Officials said the attackers placed a pistol on his temple before shooting him dead and fleeing with his bag near Sakaldiha railway station. Police probe raises security concerns The back-to-back killings inside moving trains have raised serious concerns over passenger safety on railway routes passing through eastern Uttar Pradesh. Sakaldiha Circle Officer Krishnamurari Sharma said investigators are examining all possible angles, including targeted killing and prior enmity. Railway police are now scanning passenger details, questioning witnesses and trying to identify whether the attackers boarded the train with Shah as targets already fixed.

stories.title: SP may reduce Muslim candidates in 2027 polls:Akhilesh reshapes public image through religious visits; to follow pandits' advice
stories.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav is trying to change his political image. The SP has long been seen as a party focused mainly on Muslim and Yadav voters, while the BJP has often targeted this perception during elections. Now, Akhilesh is attempting to create a new image by building the Kedareshwar temple in Etawah. He also claims that he plans his daily routine according to the advice of priests and astrologers. Political experts believe the SP may give more importance to upper caste leaders in the 2027 elections instead of relying heavily on Muslim candidates. This political shift in the SP has become more visible after the heavy defeat of the Trinamool Congress in the West Bengal elections. First, let's understand Akhilesh's image, which he inherited As soon as he took over the party, Akhilesh managed Muslim, Yadav voters Akhilesh Yadav inherited this image. After ordering firing on karsevaks in Ayodhya in 1990, the BJP started calling Mulayam Singh 'Mullah Mulayam'. After this, SP's identity became based on the Muslim-Yadav (M-Y) equation. When Akhilesh took over the party's command, he was seen as the protector of this very vote bank. Muzaffarnagar riots, BJP's allegations - soft stance for a particular community The Muzaffarnagar riots of 2013, during Akhilesh's tenure as Chief Minister, further strengthened this image. The SP government had issued a notification to provide compensation of Rs 5 lakh each only to riot-affected Muslims. This decision had to be withdrawn after the intervention of the Supreme Court. The BJP had alleged that the Akhilesh government adopted a soft stance towards the Muslim community. In March 2014, the Supreme Court also acknowledged that the government had largely failed to prevent the violence. After the Muzaffarnagar riots, a message went among Hindus that the SP government was biased towards Muslims. Now an attempt to change the image Kedareswar being built on the lines of Kedarnath Akhilesh Yadav is building 'Shri Kedareswar Mahadev Temple' in Etawah on the lines of Kedarnath temple in Uttarakhand. Akhilesh is the chief trustee of the temple. The temple is being built on the 'Shivshakti Aksh Rekha', which makes it religiously significant. Senior journalist Akhilesh Bajpai says - There is a plan to inaugurate this temple in the election year. Through this, Akhilesh wants to break the BJP's narrative, in which he is portrayed as anti-Hindu or only a benefactor of Muslims. Building a temple like Kedarnath is clearly part of a strategy to respond to BJP's Hindutva agenda. It is a different matter that Akhilesh has avoided visiting the two main Hindu temples in UP, Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi (Mathura) and Ram Mandir (Ayodhya). However, he did go for a Ganga bath during the Mahakumbh. Strategy to be decided on the suggestion of pundits and astrologers Akhilesh's press conference on May 6 surprised everyone in political circles. He had said, "Now I am taking every step on 'Pandit ji's' advice. In 2012, my government was formed under the guidance of Pandits and astrologers. Now I am walking on the same path again." Senior journalist Siddharth Kalhans says, "Akhilesh is saying that when to leave home, what color to wear, and even when to start election campaigning, all this will be decided by his astrologers." Through this, Akhilesh is trying to appease the Brahmin community. He is presenting himself as a protector of Sanatani traditions by raising issues like the insult of Brahmins and Shankaracharya. Expansion of PDA beyond the Muslim-Yadav factor Senior journalist Akhilesh Bajpai says - Akhilesh has understood that it is no longer easy to reach power in UP with the help of the Muslim-Yadav (M-Y) equation. Until the 2022 assembly elections, SP's focus remained on this equation, but they lost. In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Akhilesh gave the slogan of 'PDA' (Pichda, Dalit, Alpasankhyak - Backward, Dalit, Minority). By giving fewer tickets to Yadavs and Muslims, he bet on other backward castes and Dalits. This experiment was quite successful. BJP suffered a major dent and SP emerged as the largest party in UP. Now Akhilesh is expanding this formula in 2027. He is resorting to soft Hindutva to include upper castes in it. Possibility of major upheaval in ticket distribution Sources associated with SP say that the number of Muslim candidates may be reduced in the 2027 assembly elections. In the 2024 elections, out of SP's 62 candidates, only 4 were Muslim. The same formula may be applied in 2027 as well. Akhilesh believes that fielding more Muslim candidates will make it easier for BJP to polarize the elections. By giving fewer tickets to the Muslim community and associating himself with temples and Brahmins, Akhilesh is trying to breach a strong fortress of BJP. However, this strategy is also risky, as minority votes might scatter if tickets are reduced. Owaisi-Mayawati can harm SP Siddharth Kalahans says - The biggest challenge in front of Akhilesh's new strategy is Asaduddin Owaisi and Mayawati. If SP distances itself from the Muslim community or gives them fewer tickets, then Owaisi's AIMIM and BSP will try to fill this void. Owaisi has caused similar damage to opposition parties in Bihar, Maharashtra and Bengal. The direct benefit of scattered Muslim votes goes to BJP. BJP's New Strategy to Corner After the 2024 Victory Senior journalist Akhilesh Bajpai states - BJP had suffered losses in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. To compensate for the losses incurred due to the narrative of changing the constitution and the slogan of '400 paar' (crossing 400 seats), BJP is now working more aggressively at the booth level. However, the circumstances of the Lok Sabha elections were different. There, SP benefited from BJP's strategic mistakes, but assembly elections are fought on local issues. This is why Akhilesh is now establishing himself as a leader of all communities. Taking the help of astrology and giving importance to Brahmins is an attempt to break BJP's strategy to corner. Meanwhile, Siddharth Kalahans believes that Akhilesh's path of soft Hindutva is both his political compulsion and a well-thought-out strategy. UP has now become the center of polarized politics, where the contest is directly between SP and BJP. Amidst Mayawati's declining support base, Akhilesh is presenting himself as the only alternative to the BJP. Through building temples, astrologers' advice, and new ticket equations, he is hoping for a return to power in 2027. This strategy is quite different from 2022. Because now Akhilesh is not just doing politics of opposition, but is on the path of countering BJP's agenda in his own way. It will be interesting to see whether UP likes SP's 'new avatar' or not?

stories.title: Shah fulfils promise by making Manoj Pandey minister:Yogi cabinet filled to full strength for first time, OBC ministers rise to 25
stories.summary: The Yogi Adityanath government carried out its second cabinet expansion on Sunday, filling all 60 ministerial posts for the first time in the Chief Minister’s nine-year tenure. The reshuffle is being viewed as the BJP’s final political groundwork ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The expansion rewarded loyal leaders, addressed caste equations and attempted to strengthen the BJP’s support base across Purvanchal, Western UP, Awadh and Bundelkhand. Through the induction of OBC, Dalit and regional leaders, the BJP also tried to counter the Samajwadi Party’s PDA formula, 'Pichda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak' (Backward, Dalit and Minority). BJP counters Akhilesh Yadav’s PDA strategy The Samajwadi Party has been trying to unite backward classes and Dalits under its PDA campaign. To respond to this, the BJP included three OBC faces and two Dalit leaders in the cabinet expansion. The BJP wants to send a message that backward and Dalit communities are not only being respected but are also getting a fair share in power. The party believes this move will strengthen its hold among caste groups that could otherwise shift towards the SP. After the expansion, the number of OBC ministers increased from 22 to 25. General category ministers rose from 21 to 22. The number of Brahmin ministers increased from seven to eight, while Dalit ministers rose from eight to ten. The cabinet also includes one Sikh, one Muslim and one Scheduled Tribe minister. Cabinet expansion after more than 2 years This is the first cabinet expansion in more than two years. Political experts believe there has been no major ideological change, but the BJP has clearly focused on caste and regional representation. The reshuffle also reflects continuity in the party’s social engineering strategy. Bhupendra Chaudhary returns to cabinet Jat leader Bhupendra Chaudhary has been rewarded for maintaining close ties with the BJP’s central leadership. Chaudhary was made BJP state president in 2022 and had stepped down from his ministerial role at that time. He has now returned to the cabinet. In Western UP, Chaudhary is considered one of the BJP’s strongest Jat leaders. Unlike senior Jat minister Laxmi Narayan Chaudhary, who has earlier been associated with several parties including the SP, BSP, Congress and RLD, Bhupendra Chaudhary is seen as a core BJP cadre leader. He earlier served as Minister of State for PWD in Yogi Adityanath’s first term and was later promoted as Panchayati Raj Minister in 2019. In the second Yogi government, he again handled the Panchayati Raj portfolio before becoming the BJP state president on August 25, 2022. He remained state president until December 14, 2025. With his inclusion, the Yogi cabinet now has three Jat ministers, Bhupendra Chaudhary, Sugarcane Development Minister Laxmi Narayan Chaudhary and Minister of State KP Malik. Amit Shah keeps promise to Manoj Pandey The induction of Manoj Pandey is being seen as the fulfilment of a promise made by Union Home Minister Amit Shah. Pandey, formerly an SP MLA from Unchahar, rebelled during the Rajya Sabha elections in February 2024. He voted in favour of the BJP and reportedly helped six other SP MLAs support the party as well. At the time, Amit Shah had assured him of a ministerial role in the UP government. During the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Shah shared the stage with Manoj Pandey in Raebareli, where Pandey formally joined the BJP. Shah had also visited his residence. BJP strengthens Brahmin representation Manoj Pandey is considered an influential Brahmin face in both Awadh and Purvanchal. He has often spoken openly for Brahmin rights and publicly opposed controversial remarks made by former minister Swami Prasad Maurya against Brahmins and Sanatan Dharma. The BJP believes his inclusion could reduce dissatisfaction among Brahmin voters in Awadh and eastern UP. The move also sends a message that Brahmin dissatisfaction did not damage the BJP politically. Earlier, Jitin Prasada had represented the Brahmin quota in the state cabinet before being moved to the Centre after becoming an MP from Pilibhit. The BJP now has three prominent Brahmin faces in UP politics, Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak, Union Minister of State Jitin Prasada and newly inducted minister Manoj Pandey. Lodh community given greater representation The BJP also addressed concerns within the Lodh community. Leaders such as Dharampal Singh, BL Verma and Rajveer Singh, son of former CM Kalyan Singh, were considered contenders for BJP state president. However, the party eventually appointed Kurmi leader Pankaj Chaudhary. This reportedly created resentment among Lodh leaders, who argued that Kurmis had stronger representation in government. To balance this, Kailash Rajput from the Lodh community was inducted as minister. The cabinet now has three Lodh ministers, Dharampal Singh, Sandeep Singh and Kailash Rajput. Vishwakarma Community gets representation Hansraj Vishwakarma, a close aide of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former BJP district president in Varanasi, has also been made a minister. The Vishwakarma community has a sizeable presence in UP but previously lacked cabinet representation. With his inclusion, there are now four ministers from Varanasi in the Yogi cabinet, Anil Rajbhar, Ravindra Jaiswal, Dayashankar Mishra Dayalu and Hansraj Vishwakarma. BJP plays ‘Pasi Woman Card’ The BJP also attempted to strengthen its Dalit and women's outreach by inducting Krishna Paswan. The Pasi community has long been seen as a BJP support base. Party leaders reportedly feared the vote bank could weaken if the community did not receive stronger representation before 2027. By appointing Krishna Paswan, the BJP believes it has simultaneously addressed Dalit, Pasi and women representation. Valmiki Community strengthened further The BJP also strengthened its outreach among Valmiki voters by appointing Surendra Diler as minister. The Valmiki community is considered an important BJP support base among Dalits. After former minister Anoop Valmiki became an MP from Hathras, the Khair Assembly by-election was won by Surendra Diler, son of late MP Rajiv Diler. His induction ensures continued Valmiki representation in the cabinet. 2 ministers promoted Ajit Pal Singh and Somendra Tomar were promoted as Ministers of State (Independent Charge). Ajit Pal Singh’s promotion is aimed at retaining support from the Pal community, which both the SP and BSP are trying to attract. Somendra Tomar’s elevation comes as the SP attempts to strengthen support among Gurjars in Western UP. Women still underrepresented Despite Krishna Paswan’s induction, women remain underrepresented in the cabinet. The Yogi government now has six women ministers out of 60, making women’s representation just 10%. The women ministers include Baby Rani Maurya, Gulab Devi, Rajni Tiwari, Pratibha Shukla, Vijay Lakshmi Gautam and Krishna Paswan. Youngest cabinet so far The current cabinet is younger than Yogi Adityanath’s first government. In 2022, the average age of ministers was 55 years. It has now dropped to 52.8 years. Surendra Diler, aged 33, is the youngest minister in the cabinet, while Dr Arun Kumar Saxena, aged around 74, is the oldest.

stories.title: ‘Darling, I leaked two papers for you, come and meet’:Lucknow University professor accused of pressuring student and harassment
stories.summary: A BSc final year student of Lucknow University has accused an Assistant Professor of harassment and paper leak pressure. The student alleged that Assistant Professor Dr Paramjit Singh called her during leave and asked her to return before the exam, claiming that the question paper had already been leaked for her. During the phone call, the professor allegedly told the student, “Darling, I’ve leaked the paper for you. Come back from home before the exam. We will give you the paper here.” He also asked about her mother’s health and repeatedly pressured her to return early from leave. At first, the student refused to come back, but later agreed during the conversation. However, after the call ended, she was heard in the audio saying that she did not want the leaked paper and feared being harassed again. The matter has now reached the university administration, which has taken it seriously. An inquiry has been started against the Assistant Professor. The university has also approached the police to register a case, and the student’s statement will be recorded as part of the investigation. Claim of both Main Subject and Elective papers being leaked The accused professor is from the Zoology Department. On a phone call, he claimed to the student that both the core or main subject and elective (optional subject) papers had been leaked. During the conversation, the accused professor can also be heard pressuring the student to meet before the exam. However, the student can be heard continuously refusing to meet. Now read the conversation happening in the audio Professor- Child, is mom okay? Student- Yes sir. Everything is fine. Professor- Okay, good, let me know if you need any help. Most doctors at KGMU and PGI are known to me. Alright darling if you say so, I'll come myself. Let me know if you need any financial support too. Everything is open for you. Student- No sir, there's no such problem. Everything will be done. I also need to look after things at home right now. Professor- No, I'll tell you which day we should meet? I have gotten both the core and elective papers ready for you. Student- No sir, I have already studied. My syllabus is complete. Professor- Oh man, I have gotten the entire paper ready for you. Just come. Student- I have already studied, sir. Professor- So, won't you come to meet me once? Student- Sir, I need to look after mom a bit. Because of this, staying at home is important. Professor- So tell me, by when will you come to meet me once? Student- Sir, let me settle down a bit at home. Professor- So, within seven days? Student- Sir, I'll come after the exams are over. Professor- Come to meet me, I've leaked both papers for you. Student- Okay, I'll try. I'll see at home, I'll come whenever I can manage to leave. Professor- Not 'try', you absolutely have to come. Okay, come within 4 days. Student- Yes sir Professor- Okay, okay After this, the conversation between the professor and the student stops. Then the student is heard saying- So this man is calling me. I will not go. I don't want the papers. He is calling me to his office so he can molest me again. University spokesperson said - strict action will be taken University spokesperson Prof. Mukul Srivastava said, the matter has been taken into serious consideration. An investigation process has been initiated in this regard. Strict action will be taken against the culprit after the investigation is complete. Meanwhile, Prof. Amita Kanojia, Head of the Zoology Department, said - The audio has come to our attention. I have also heard it. The voice seems to be that of the same professor. Exam Controller filed a complaint with the police Lucknow University's Chief Proctor Prof. Rakesh Dwivedi said- After the audio came to light, a complaint has been filed with Hasanganj police station on behalf of the Exam Controller to register an FIR against the accused Assistant Professor. Additionally, the Internal Complaint Committee constituted under the Vishakha Committee has also started an investigation. Action will be taken very soon in this matter.The Controller of Examinations stated in his complaint - Three audio recordings of objectionable conversations between Dr. Paramjit Singh, Assistant Professor of Zoology Department, and a female student on the night of May 14 and 15, 2026, have been received.The professor made inappropriate proposals to the student and offered to leak two university exam papers for personal gain. This is a serious matter against the confidentiality of the examination and the dignity of the student. The pen drive containing the audio recordings has been submitted along with the complaint letter.News is being updated

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:SC stays Delhi HC order suspending ex-BJP MLA's life term in Unnao rape case; NEET-UG 2026 re-exam on 21 June more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from UP and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day- 1. NTA schedules NEET-UG 2026 re-exam for June 21 The National Testing Agency has officially scheduled the NEET-UG 2026 re-examination for Sunday, 21 June 2026. The exam held on 3 May 2026 was cancelled following paper leak allegations. The agency clarified that no fresh registration or additional fee will be required for the re-exam, and new admit cards will be issued. 2. SC sets aside BJP ex-MLA Kuldeep Sengar's sentence suspension in Unnao rape case, orders fresh HC hearing The Supreme Court on Friday quashed the Delhi High Court order suspending former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar’s life sentence in the 2017 Unnao rape case. The apex court directed the High Court to hear the matter afresh and deliver a fresh decision within two months. 3. Gorakhpur gets first robotic restaurant, ‘Robo Didi’ serves and greets guests Gorakhpur’s first robotic restaurant has opened near Nauka Vihar, where a robot named “Robo Didi” serves food and greets customers. Brought from Hyderabad, the robot wishes guests on birthdays and anniversaries and can work for nearly eight hours on a single charge before returning automatically to its station. 4. PM Modi concludes UAE visit, departs for Netherlands Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday concluded his visit to the United Arab Emirates and departed for the Netherlands as part of his five-nation tour. UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan personally saw off the Prime Minister at the airport, underlining the close ties between the two nations. 5. Mayawati asks Akhilesh to apologise to Brahmins over SP leader’s remarks BSP chief Mayawati on Friday demanded an apology from Akhilesh Yadav to the Brahmin community after controversial remarks by SP leader Rajkumar Bhati. She accused the Samajwadi Party of continuing caste-based politics and urged immediate action amid the growing row. 6. BJP Yuva Morcha leader shot in Lucknow, family alleges land mafia links BJP Yuva Morcha leader Chetan Tiwari was allegedly shot by Vaibhav Bajpai in Lucknow’s Mehendiganj area. The victim’s family accused the accused of land grabbing, running illegal settlements and operating a criminal network using political influence. Chetan remains under treatment in hospital. 7. 'India can play 'greater role' for peace in West Asia' Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi said India can play a “greater role” in bringing peace to West Asia. Addressing a press conference here, he said there is no military solution to anything related to Iran. He also said Iran is ready to help pass all vessels through the Strait of Hormuz, adding that the situation in the Strait of Hormuz is very complicated now. 8. Eight get bail in Varanasi Ganga boat iftar case after 60 days Eight accused in the Varanasi Ganga boat iftar case were granted bail by the Allahabad High Court after spending 60 days in jail. Police had alleged the group hijacked a boat and organised an iftar gathering midstream on the Ganga. Bail pleas of six others will be heard on May 18. 9. Eleven of Gorakhpur family hospitalised after suspected food poisoning incident Eleven members of a family, including two children, were hospitalised in Gorakhpur after suffering vomiting, diarrhoea and breathing problems. Health officials suspect food poisoning after the family consumed watermelon and Maggi. A medical team will visit the village to investigate the exact cause of the illness. 10. Indian markets fall amid rising oil prices Indian stock markets reversed early gains and settled lower on Friday, 15 May 2026. The 30-share Sensex closed at 75,237.99 points, and the 50-share Nifty closed flat but in red at 23,643.50 points. Oil Marketing Company (OMC) stocks opened under pressure after the government of India increased petrol diesel prices by ₹3 per litre each.

stories.title: 8 accused get bail in Varanasi Ganga boat iftar case:Spent 60 days in jail, hearing for others on May 18
stories.summary: Eight accused arrested in the Varanasi Ganga boat iftar party case were granted bail after spending 60 days in jail. The bail plea of the remaining six accused will be heard in the Allahabad High Court on Monday, May 18. The division bench of Justice Rajiv Lochan Shukla and Justice Jitendra Kumar Sinha granted bail to the accused. The first bail petition was filed on behalf of Danish Saifi, Aamir Kaifi and Nurul Islam. Later, the remaining accused also moved separate petitions. The court heard the bail pleas of all 14 accused together. The case was registered on March 16 after BJP Yuva Morcha city president Rajat Jaiswal filed an FIR at Kotwali police station in Varanasi. Police arrested all 14 accused the same day. The accused were denied bail by the ACP court at Police Lines and were sent to jail. On April 28, police produced all the accused before the court. Police claim boatman was kidnapped and boat hijacked During an earlier hearing on April 28, police told the Allahabad High Court that the accused had allegedly kidnapped the boatman and hijacked the boat on March 15 before organising the iftar party in the middle of the Ganga river. According to police, the youths threatened the boatman and forced him to operate the boat. Police said the boatman tried to stop them during the party, but the group ignored him. Police also claimed that videos and photographs of the party were intentionally made to send a message beyond Varanasi. According to the prosecution, such an iftar gathering had never been organised in this manner on the Ganga in Kashi before. The videos allegedly showed visuals of a mosque, the Ganga river, arrangements on the boat and separate shots of chicken biryani. Police also told the court that the accused tried to project themselves as influential. Earlier, on April 17, the High Court had given the Uttar Pradesh government one week to file its counter affidavit. Video of iftar party triggered controversy The controversy began after videos of the iftar party surfaced on social media. The clips showed people having iftar on a boat in the middle of the Ganga river. Young men were seen consuming fruits, soft drinks and food during the gathering. According to the FIR, chicken biryani was also served along with fruits and dry fruits. After the videos circulated online, Hindu organisations and BJP workers objected to the event. Following the complaint filed by Rajat Jaiswal, police arrested 14 people within eight hours. All accused belong to Madanpura area Police said all 14 accused are residents of the Tadtalla area in Madanpura, Varanasi, and belong to the same extended family. Several of them are associated with a family locally known as “Babu Bidi Wale”. Those named in the case include Mohammad Awwal, Mohammad Sameer, Mohammad Ahmed, Noor Islam, Mohammad Faizan, Azad Ali, Mohammad Tahaseem, Mahfooz Alam, Nehal Afridi, Mohammad Tausif, Aamir Kaifi, Mohammad Anas and Danish Saifi. Police said all the accused are between 19 and 25 years old.

stories.title: Engineer posts final video before suicide in Gorakhpur:Family alleges dowry case pressure affected career mental health
stories.summary: A 33-year-old engineer from Uttar Pradesh allegedly died by suicide in Gorakhpur after recording an emotional final video in which he blamed prolonged marital disputes and harassment by his wife for pushing him towards death. The body of Pradumn Yadav, a resident of Kushinagar, was found hanging from a tree near Budhiya Mai temple inside Kusumhi forest on Thursday. Before taking the extreme step, he visited the temple and recorded a 1-minute-48-second video showing the noose tied to the tree. Final video raises disturbing questions In the video, Pradumn appeared emotionally broken and repeatedly spoke about the mental stress he had been facing for years. He said he no longer wished to live because of the suffering caused by his wife. He also appealed to people not to call his death untimely and admitted that thoughts of suicide had occupied his mind for the past one-and-a-half months. Key points from the video: Yadav was working with a private company in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. He had married Arpita Yadav on June 2, 2017. The couple had a five-year-old daughter. According to family members, the relationship turned bitter within months of marriage and disputes had continued for nearly six years. His brother Raghavendra alleged that after marriage, Arpita stayed briefly at her in-laws’ house before moving back to her maternal home. Later, when Pradumn took her to Delhi where he was employed at the time, the relationship worsened further. Family claims legal cases increased pressure The family alleged that after returning to her maternal home, Arpita filed dowry harassment and maintenance cases against Pradumn. Hearings in the matter had been continuing for several years. According to relatives: Temple visit before final step After attending the hearing, Pradumn reportedly visited his brother-in-law’s house in Hata and later travelled towards Gorakhpur to catch a train. On the way, he stopped at Budhiya Mai temple located deep inside Kusumhi forest, around 12 kilometres from Gorakhpur city. Police said he tied a towel to a tree near the temple, recorded the video and uploaded it as his WhatsApp status before hanging himself. A villager later spotted the body and alerted the police, who identified him through his mobile phone and identity documents. Family left devastated after death The engineer’s death has left the family shattered. His elderly parents, Umapati Yadav and Kalawati Devi, were inconsolable after receiving the news. Relatives said Pradumn had been under severe emotional and legal stress for years and struggled to balance court proceedings with his professional responsibilities. Police have begun an investigation and are examining the video and other digital evidence linked to the case.

stories.title: From childhood to final journey, Prateek's life in 25 photos:Married Aparna for love, enjoyed bodybuilding and flying planes
stories.summary: Prateek Yadav, the younger brother of Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, passed away at the age of 38. His last rites were held on May 14 at Bhaisakund in Lucknow, where several political leaders and family members gathered to pay their final respects. Among those present were Akhilesh Yadav, Shivpal Yadav, Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak and many other dignitaries. Prateek died on May 13, leaving his family and close friends in shock. Prateek and Aparna Yadav first met at a friend’s birthday party in 2001. At that time, Aparna was not aware that Prateek was the son of former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Mulayam Singh Yadav. After their first meeting, the two stayed in touch and Prateek asked for Aparna’s email address. Their friendship later turned into a relationship, and they dated for nearly 11 years. In December 2011, Prateek and Aparna got married in a grand ceremony in Saifai. Several well-known personalities, including Amitabh Bachchan, attended the wedding. The couple later welcomed their daughter, Prathama. While Prateek focused on his gym and business activities, Aparna entered politics and eventually joined the BJP. stories.title: Special camps for smart meter consumers begin in Lucknow:Complaints, bill correction and new connection services till May 30
stories.summary: The capital city of Lucknow has launched a special campaign to resolve complaints of smart meter consumers. The drive is being conducted by Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (MVVNL). Under the campaign, special camps will be organised at electricity sub-stations across the city from May 15 to May 30, 2026. Consumers can visit sub-stations in Amausi, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow Central and Jankipuram zones to get their complaints resolved. The camps will remain open from 10 am to 5 pm. Officials said reports of all complaints received during the campaign will also be prepared. The campaign is being carried out under the RDSS scheme on the directions of Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited to resolve issues related to prepaid smart meters. Consumers asked to bring relevant documents Director (Commerce) Rajat Juneja said consumers should carry all necessary documents related to their complaints while visiting the camps. stories.title: 11 family members hospitalised in Gorakhpur:Vomiting, diarrhoea reported, food poisoning likely; team to investigate village
stories.summary: A total of 11 members of a single family have been admitted to the district hospital in Gorakhpur after complaining of vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Family members said that all of them had eaten watermelon at night, followed by Maggi. The incident took place in the Beliapar police station area. On Thursday morning, neighbours first took the affected people to a Community Health Centre (CHC), and later they were admitted to the district hospital in the afternoon. A 2-year-old girl is also among the patients. Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Dr Rajesh Jha said that, according to the initial information given by the family, the case appears to be food poisoning. However, to determine the exact cause, a medical team will be sent to the village on Friday. He added that the situation is currently under control. Full incident details Annu Pandey, daughter of Amarnath Pandey of Malav village in Beliapar area, said that on Wednesday evening a street vendor came selling watermelon, and the family purchased it. Around 8 pm, all family members ate the watermelon. About an hour later, Maggi was prepared at home on the children’s insistence. The Maggi was eaten by Amarnath Pandey (65), his brother Baijnath Pandey (68), mother Shail Kumari (63), brother Anshu Pandey (26), and sister Purnima Pandey (25). In addition, Balram Pandey’s son Vedant (3) and Hunnu (2), Lakshmikant Pandey’s daughter Neha, relative Jagdish Dubey (80), and Saurabh Tripathi (25) also consumed watermelon and Maggi. Around 1 am, one after another, everyone began falling ill. deteriorating. Condition worsened, local unqualified doctor treatment ineffective According to the family, around 1 am children first started vomiting, followed by diarrhoea. Soon, elders in the house also developed stomach pain, vomiting and diarrhoea. They also began experiencing breathing difficulties. As the condition worsened, the family consulted a local unqualified practitioner in the village and took some medicines, but there was no improvement. As the condition kept deteriorating, by morning neighbours arranged for them to be taken to the local CHC. After initial treatment there, doctors referred them to the district hospital. All 11 patients were admitted to the emergency ward, where treatment was started. Dr RP Gautam said that all 11 patients from the same family have been admitted and are out of danger. They are being monitored and will be discharged once their condition improves. CMO checked on the patients' condition CMO Dr Rajesh Jha also visited the hospital and met the patients. He took details from the family and discussed the situation with doctors. He said the patients are stable and the case appears to be food poisoning. He added that a medical team will visit the village on Friday to investigate the matter further. The CMO also said that consuming cold food items followed by hot food can sometimes lead to bacterial infection in the stomach, which can cause illness.

stories.title: Mayawati demands Akhilesh Yadav apologise to Brahmin community:Urges immediate action amid caste row controversy
stories.summary: Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has strongly reacted after Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Rajkumar Bhati made controversial remarks on the Brahmin community. Posting on X on Friday, she termed the SP spokesperson’s statement as irresponsible and urged SP chief Akhilesh Yadav to take immediate cognisance of the matter, apologise to the Brahmin community and express regret. She further said that the SP’s caste-based mindset and politics had not changed, rather it had deepened further. According to her, the statement has deeply hurt the self-respect of the entire Brahmin community. Controversial video triggers backlash and apology The controversy began after a video of Rajkumar Bhati surfaced two days ago in which he was heard quoting a saying that Brahmins and sex workers were being compared in a derogatory manner. The remarks sparked anger from the World Brahmin Federation and members of the community. Following the backlash, Bhati later issued a video apology. Watch Rajkumar Bhati's VIDEO Now know what Mayawati said on this 1- 'SP which does casteist politics is silent, this is escalating the matter' Mayawati said an SP national spokesperson had recently made indecent and objectionable remarks about the Brahmin community, leading to widespread outrage. She noted that despite a police case being registered, the issue continues to escalate. She added that the SP leadership’s silence on what she called caste-based politics is worsening the situation and increasing tension. 2- The self-respect of the Brahmin community was hurt by the SP spokesperson's statement The former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister said the irresponsible statement had hurt the dignity and self-respect of the Brahmin community. She stressed that SP leadership must take immediate action and apologise to the community. 3- ‘In BSP there is no "use and throw", but the welfare of all communities is protected’ Mayawati also took a swipe at the Uttar Pradesh government, saying that there is visible resentment in the Brahmin community regarding its approach, which is not hidden from anyone. She added that BSP has always ensured respect and participation for all communities, including Brahmins, and highlighted that unlike others, BSP follows a policy of inclusion rather than “use and throw”. Read what people said about Rajkumar Bhati's statement SP leader defends himself, issues clarification apology After the controversy escalated, Rajkumar Bhati posted a video on X apologising and said that if his words hurt the sentiments of the Brahmin community, he deeply regrets it. He said he follows socialist ideology and would never support discrimination against any caste or religion. He also alleged that BJP and its IT cell were running a campaign against him. Bhati added that he respects the Brahmin community, which has produced scholars, warriors, and intellectuals. Bhati explains context of his remarks Bhati clarified that the remarks were made during a literary discussion event held at Jawahar Bhawan in Delhi on May 5. He said the discussion was based on caste and communal issues, with several intellectuals participating. He said he referred to commonly used derogatory sayings that exist across communities and mentioned that such expressions exist on both sides. He claimed he did not endorse the offensive couplet and had even said it was inappropriate and should not be used. He added that selective clips of his speech were being used to target him, and people should watch the full video to understand the context.

stories.title: SC quashes Delhi HC order suspending Sengar’s sentence:Remits Unnao rape case to High Court for fresh decision
stories.summary: The Supreme Court of India on Friday set aside a Delhi High Court order that had suspended the life sentence of former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar in the 2017 Unnao rape case. A bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi directed the Delhi High Court to hear the matter again and deliver a fresh decision within two months, without being influenced by the Supreme Court’s observations. The top court also asked the High Court to hear Sengar’s appeal and decide the criminal case as quickly as possible. During the hearing, the Supreme Court said the High Court’s earlier order was “partially correct and partially incorrect” and observed that several issues needed closer examination. The Supreme Court had earlier stayed the Delhi High Court order after the Central Bureau of Investigation challenged the decision. | High Court refuses to stay Kuldeep Sengar’s sentence Sengar serving life sentence in 2017 Unnao rape case Sengar is serving a life sentence after being convicted in the 2017 Unnao rape case involving a minor girl. The case had triggered nationwide outrage and intense political controversy. The survivor accused Sengar of raping her at his residence in Unnao after allegedly promising to help her get a job. The case drew national attention after the survivor and her family repeatedly accused police of inaction and alleged intimidation by Sengar’s associates. Public anger increased in 2018 when the survivor attempted self-immolation outside the residence of Yogi Adityanath in Lucknow, claiming no action had been taken against the powerful politician. The controversy deepened after the survivor’s father died in judicial custody under suspicious circumstances following his arrest in a case allegedly linked to Sengar’s aides. Supreme Court moved trial to Delhi over fairness concerns In 2019, the Supreme Court transferred all cases linked to the matter from Uttar Pradesh to Delhi, citing concerns over fairness and witness safety. The same year, the survivor and her lawyer were seriously injured in a suspicious road accident in Rae Bareli, while two of her relatives were killed. The incident led to allegations of a conspiracy to eliminate the survivor and brought even greater national attention to the case. In December 2019, a Delhi court convicted Sengar under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced him to life imprisonment. The court also imposed a fine and ordered compensation for the survivor. Over the years, the case has become one of India’s most politically sensitive criminal cases, raising questions about political influence, protection for sexual assault survivors and the criminal justice system.

stories.title: Ranbir Kapoor buys ₹3.31 crore land in Ayodhya:Joins Amitabh Bachchan in investing in 'The Saryu' project, to play Lord Ram in 'Ramayana'
stories.summary: Actor Ranbir Kapoor has bought land in Ayodhya's real estate project 'The Saryu'. This project is a premium plotted development project by ‘The House of Abhinandan Lodha’ (HoABL). News agency ANI reported that, according to the company's official announcement, the deal was made for ₹3.31 crore. The total area of the purchased land is 2,134 square feet. After Amitabh Bachchan, Ranbir Kapoor has become the second renowned actor to invest in 'The Saryu'. 'The Saryu' is a 75-acre project located on the banks of the Saryu River. The project includes a grand clubhouse, more than 35 lifestyle amenities, and a five-acre pure vegetarian luxury hotel by The Leela Hotels. ‘Ayodhya chose me’: Ranbir Ranbir said in a statement that he feels Ayodhya has chosen him. He said that Ayodhya is an important part of India's history and cultural heritage, and this land in 'The Sarayu' will become a part of his family's legacy. Abhinandan Lodha, Chairman of HoABL, said that Ayodhya is undergoing a period of cultural and economic renaissance. He said that due to infrastructure, tourism, and attracting global attention, the city has long-term development potential. He said that Ranbir Kapoor's investment shows that buyers are looking at Ayodhya not only emotionally but also from a future perspective as an important investment destination. Ranbir to play Lord Ram in 'Ramayana' Notably, this investment has come at a time when Ranbir is playing the role of Lord Shri Ram in director Nitesh Tiwari's film 'Ramayana'. On the occasion of Hanuman Jayanti, Ranbir's look as Lord Ram from the film was also revealed. See a glimpse of Lord Ram's look- In the video, Ranbir Kapoor was also seen wielding a bow as Lord Ram. stories.title: Lucknow man kills wife over suspected affair:Body stuffed in trolley bag, later held at police station after filing missing complaint
stories.summary: A man in Lucknow allegedly killed his wife over suspicion of an affair and dumped her body in a trolley bag near Indira Dam. He later went to the police station and reported her missing. However, repeated changes in his statement raised suspicion, following which police arrested him. During strict interrogation, he confessed to the murder. Acting on his statement, police recovered the body, sent it for post-mortem, and took the accused into custody. The incident took place in Chinhat. The deceased has been identified as 24-year-old Yasmin, wife of Altaf alias Kallu. Dispute occurred at night, murder committed at dawn Yasmin, daughter of vegetable trader Mohammad Shaheed, had been married to Altaf alias Kallu, a resident of Chinhat, for six years. The couple has a daughter and a son. On 14 May around 8 am, Altaf reached Chinhat police station and informed police that his wife was missing. When police questioned him, he kept changing his statements, which raised suspicion. During interrogation, he said he suspected that Yasmin was having an affair with a close relative, which often led to disputes between them. He said that on the night of 13 May, they again had an argument over the same issue. Early on 14 May around 4 am, he strangled Yasmin to death. Loaded the bag containing the body onto an e-rickshaw and took it to Indira Dam Altaf told police that about an hour after the murder, he packed the body in a trolley bag and brought it to Chinhat market. He then booked an e-rickshaw and went to Indira Dam. After reaching there, he got off the e-rickshaw, carried the bag to the banks of the dam, and dumped it in the bushes. He then returned home and informed his family that Yasmin was missing. On their advice, he went to the police station to file a missing complaint. Police recovered the body stuffed in the bag After Altaf confessed to the crime, police took him into custody and reached the Indira Dam area based on his disclosure. The body was recovered from the location he had mentioned. Police have sent the body for post-mortem and are continuing further investigation.

stories.title: BJP Yuva Morcha leader shot in Lucknow:Family alleges land grab, illegal settlement, criminal network behind attack
stories.summary: The family of accused Vaibhav Bajpai, who shot BJP Yuva Morcha Lucknow metropolitan executive member Chetan Tiwari, is alleged to be highly influential and feared in the area. Locals claim the family maintains dominance in the region and is often involved in such incidents to assert control. It is alleged that the accused have encroached upon the land of Yogeshwar Rishikul Girls Inter College located in Mehendiganj and developed an illegal settlement there. Chetan’s brother has further alleged that people hired on rent are being forced into illegal and immoral activities. He claims no action is taken due to the influence of powerful connections. An illegal parking area has also been set up on the same land, for which monthly rent is being collected. First understand the entire matter Chetan Tiwari, son of Suresh Chand Tiwari, a resident of Mehendiganj and member of the BJP Yuva Morcha Lucknow metropolitan working committee, was constructing a parking area outside his house between 9 pm and 10 pm on April 9. At that time, Vaibhav Bajpai alias Kaustubh Bajpai, a resident of the same locality, arrived on foot carrying a pistol. Before anyone could understand what was happening, Vaibhav opened fire on Chetan. Chetan was hit and fell on the road. When his associate Udayraj Rawat rushed to save him, Vaibhav also fired at him, but he was not hit. After hearing the commotion, people gathered at the spot and the accused fled. Chetan is still under treatment in hospital. Now read about the dark deeds of the accused... Settlement Established by Occupying School Land Chetan Tiwari’s elder brother Rajneesh Tiwari alleged that in Mehendiganj, the land of Yogeshwar Rishikul Girls Inter College, where Jaipuria School is also located, has been partially encroached by Vaibhav. He further alleged that Bangladeshi and Rohingya individuals have been settled there. He claimed that such activities are routinely carried out and that those residing there are involved in illegal activities. He also alleged illegal charging for e-rickshaw battery charging facilities. He further said that due to political influence, no action has been taken. He alleged that encroachment and land grabbing are a habitual practice of the accused. He further claimed that if an elderly woman is living alone in a house, they approach her and later take possession of the property through killing or other means. Occupied the land given on lease Rajneesh Tiwari stated that in 1972, during the tenure of Chief Minister Kamalapati Tripathi, Shri Yogeshwar Rishikul Inter College and Yogeshwar Rishikul Girls Inter College were operating in the area. The management had sought land from the government for running schools. For the education of children, the government allotted 22 bigha land in Rajajipuram to Shri Yogeshwar Rishikul Inter College in 1976 on lease for running the institution. He said the government imposed conditions that the land could neither be used for any other purpose, nor sold, gifted, or transferred. Allegation - Vaibhav engages in hooliganism with the support of his contractor father The victim’s family alleged that Vaibhav’s father Santosh Kumar Bajpei works as a contractor with the Municipal Corporation. Vaibhav also assisted him in contracting work and allegedly used that influence to establish dominance in the area through intimidation and violence. The family said several complaints were made to police stations earlier, but no action was taken. During police questioning, Vaibhav allegedly admitted to old enmity with Chetan Tiwari and said he fired at him with the intention to kill due to a long-standing dispute. The accused and victim were friends until 3 years ago Vaibhav told police that till 2023, he and Chetan were close friends. He said his grandfather Puttan Bajpai was given the title of “Maharaj” by locals. Two years ago, Chetan Tiwari also started using “Maharaj” after his name, which led to a dispute between them. He said their friendship gradually turned into rivalry. In December 2024, Chetan filed a complaint against Vaibhav and his family, leading to two FIRs being registered. Other accused have not been arrested yet Chetan Tiwari’s wife has filed an FIR naming Vaibhav Bajpai, Harshit Bajpai and 4–5 unidentified persons under charges of attempt to murder and 10 other sections. One accused, Vaibhav, surrendered at the police station, while the remaining accused are still absconding. The victim’s family is demanding their arrest.

stories.title: CBI begins probe into Ansal land scam:Seeks original documents from LDA, questions land sale to Tulsiani
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has taken over the investigation into the high-profile Sushant Golf City land scam in Lucknow. The agency registered a case on April 8, 2026 against Ansal Properties and Infrastructure Limited and others, and has begun its probe. Following this, the agency has sought detailed information and original documents from the Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) on 13 key points. The CBI, two days ago, sent a letter to LDA Vice Chairman Prathamesh Kumar. It stated that investigation is being conducted under case number RC 219 2026 E 0008 under Sections 120-B and 420 of the IPC and the Prevention of Corruption Act. The agency has asked under what process and conditions the land was allotted to Ansal. Questions raised over land sale to Tulsiyani Builder The CBI has also sought clarification on under which rules or policies Ansal Properties and Infrastructure Limited transferred land meant for a group housing project to Tulsiani Construction and Developers Private Limited. Records related to NOC, permissions and licence amendments have also been demanded. Township Policy and Mortgaged Land Investigation The investigating agency has also asked for a copy of the township policy under which Ansal was granted a licence to develop the township. Details have also been sought regarding which land parcels were mortgaged for the project, what changes were later made in them, and whether any criminal case was registered in case of violations. The CBI has also asked for names, designations and contact details of officials who handled files related to the project. Notice Issued Under Section 91 The CBI has directed that all original documents be submitted at its headquarters in New Delhi. The agency has treated this as a notice under Section 91 of the Criminal Procedure Code and has asked for the matter to be treated as top priority. LDA Vice Chairman Prathamesh Kumar confirmed that the CBI had registered the case in April. Some documents have already been provided, while remaining records are being sent. stories.title: Prateek built business empire away from politics:17 companies linked to family associates; daughters inherit crores worth of assets and properties
stories.summary: Real estate ventures, a lavish bungalow, premium gyms, a ₹5-crore Lamborghini, and a royal lifestyle — these defined the public image of Prateek Yadav, the younger son of late Samajwadi Party founder Mulayam Singh Yadav. Prateek, who stayed away from active politics and built his identity in the real estate and fitness industries, died at the age of 38. The cause of death has been reported as cardiac arrest. His wife, Aparna Yadav, is a BJP leader and currently serves as Vice-Chairperson of the Uttar Pradesh State Women Commission. Let's find out how much wealth and what legacy Prateek, who built his own world amidst political influence, has left behind... Successful businessman, but no company registered in his name Unlike other members of the Yadav political family, Prateek Yadav was not directly associated with politics. He completed his education at the University of Leeds and was regarded as a successful businessman. However, official records reportedly show that no company was directly registered in his name. According to government documents, Prateek owned movable and immovable assets worth nearly ₹19.56 crore, including ₹13.41 crore in movable assets and ₹6.15 crore in immovable property. Among these assets was a Lamborghini worth ₹5.21 crore. Reports say he had taken a loan of ₹4.5 crore from Union Bank of India to purchase the luxury car. His annual income from business and assets was said to be ₹1.47 crore, according to details mentioned in Aparna Yadav’s election affidavit during the 2015-16 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Indirect links to multiple companies Sources close to the family and company documents suggest that Prateek was never officially listed as a director or designated director in any company. However, he allegedly maintained indirect control over several firms. Most of these businesses were reportedly operated in the names of Aparna Yadav’s brother Aman Singh Bisht and close associates. Aman Bisht linked to 17 companies After the Samajwadi Party formed the government in Uttar Pradesh in 2012, Aman Bisht and his associates reportedly established 17 companies by May 2018. These companies included Fame Infra City, Fame Sky Ventures, Sunshine Sky Ventures, Guiding Tree, ACME Skyventures, Shri Shekhar Infratech Private Limited, Shri Shakti Infrazone Private Limited, Monal Infraheights Private Limited, Shukra Construction Private Limited, DB Infrazone Private Limited, Robust Real Buildcon Private Limited, Robust Realtors Private Limited, and Robust Residency Private Limited. People familiar with the matter claimed that the operational control of these companies remained with Prateek Yadav. Reports of disputes between Aman Bisht and Prateek over financial transactions involving these firms had also surfaced in the past. Owned luxury property in Lucknow Prateek built a lavish residence in Gautampalli, a high-security and upscale locality in Lucknow’s Hazratganj area. He lived there with Aparna Yadav and their two daughters, Prathama and Padmaja. The house is located on Vikramaditya Marg, considered one of Lucknow’s most elite residential zones. Apart from this, Prateek reportedly owned 22 bighas of agricultural land in Ramaiyapur village near Lucknow. He also possessed a 5,123-square-foot residential building on Mahatma Gandhi Marg in the Cantonment area. Built ‘Iron Core Fit’ into a fitness brand Prateek Yadav was highly active in the fitness industry. In 2015, he launched a fitness brand called Iron Core Fit, which later expanded into multiple branches. Sources said the gym featured imported fitness equipment from abroad. Annual membership fees reportedly went up to ₹35,000. He also operated another major gym near Manoj Pandey Chauraha in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow. Apart from gyms, he was involved in fitness training, brand promotions, and wellness consulting. Prateek was also active on social media, where he frequently shared workout videos and fitness tips. Many followers viewed him as a fitness icon. No property in Saifai despite Yadav family roots Although the political identity of the Yadav family is closely tied to Saifai, Prateek reportedly owned neither land nor a house there. Family sources said that whenever he visited Saifai, he stayed at Mulayam Singh Yadav’s residence. However, Prateek and his family rarely stayed there and mostly visited only during family events or major Samajwadi Party functions. Personal life and relationship with Aparna Yadav Prateek’s mother, Sadhana Gupta, married Chandra Prakash Gupta in 1986, and Prateek was born in 1987. The couple divorced in 1990, after which Sadhana grew close to Mulayam Singh Yadav. Mulayam married Sadhana Gupta in 2003 and publicly accepted Prateek as his son. Prateek married Aparna Yadav in a love marriage around 14 years ago. Earlier this year, on January 19, he unexpectedly announced his decision to divorce Aparna, accusing her of making his life “hell.” However, the couple reconciled within nine days. Prateek later shared a photograph with Aparna on Instagram and captioned it, “All is Good.” Death and Funeral Prateek Yadav died at around 6 am on May 13 at the age of 38. His post-mortem report cited cardiac arrest as the cause of death, though viscera samples have been preserved for further examination. His last rites were performed on May 14 in Lucknow. Aparna Yadav’s father, Arvind Singh Bisht, lit the funeral pyre. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav paid his final respects by placing wood on his brother’s pyre.

stories.title: Medical costs rising sharply in UP:Even 5-year-olds facing stress; over 70% people depend on private hospitals
stories.summary: Two incidents from Uttar Pradesh highlight how rising medical expenses are pushing families into severe financial distress: These cases underline the growing healthcare burden in the state. A recent National Statistics Office (NSO) survey revealed that people in Uttar Pradesh spent nearly ₹28,000 crore from their own pockets on medical treatment between January and December 2025. Treatment cost higher in rural government hospitals A National Statistics Office (NSO) survey titled Household Social Consumption: Health revealed that patients in Uttar Pradesh spend an average of ₹14,000 even when admitted to government hospitals. Surprisingly, treatment costs in rural government hospitals are higher than in urban ones. According to the survey, treatment in an urban government hospital costs an average of ₹10,547, while patients in rural government hospitals spend around ₹16,650. Expenses rise sharply in private hospitals, about ₹75,000 in urban private hospitals and nearly ₹38,000 in rural private hospitals. Private hospitals cost 6–7 times more for common illnesses The survey found that treatment for seasonal illnesses such as cold, cough, and fever is 6–7 times more expensive in private hospitals compared to government facilities. Treatment for such illnesses costs around ₹466 in a rural government hospital, while the same treatment in a private hospital costs nearly ₹2,457. Normal delivery costs over ₹31,000 in private hospitals The survey also highlighted the sharp difference in maternity expenses. The average cost of a normal delivery in a government hospital is ₹2,607, while the same procedure in a private hospital costs around ₹31,137. Overall, the average delivery expense stands at ₹13,434. Trust in private doctors instead of government doctors In UP, 8 out of every 100 are sick NSO conducted a survey in 1192 rural and 700 urban blocks of UP between January and December 2025. In this, health-related information of 80,477 people from 15,096 families was collected. In the survey, the pattern of people falling ill was observed over two types of time periods. The survey revealed that 8 out of 100 people in UP fall ill every 15 days. This figure is lower than the national average of 13. The highest number is in Kerala, where 25 out of 100 people fall ill every 15 days. Children troubled by infection, youth by digestion, and elderly by heart problems According to the NSO survey, last year, 26% of patients admitted to hospitals were under 30 years of age. Meanwhile, 45% of children up to 14 years of age had to be admitted to the hospital due to infection. Digestion-related problems were more common among patients aged 15 to 44 years. About 15% of those admitted were due to this. Heart diseases were found to be more prevalent among patients above 45 years of age. The UP government spent about 17 thousand crore rupees in 2025-26 on facilities like free medicines, free tests, ambulances, and vaccinations (which directly benefit the common man). However, the government's health budget was 50 thousand crore rupees. This also includes expenses like salaries, pensions, and infrastructure.

stories.title: Storms lash 37 UP districts with strong winds:Putin condoles loss of 111 lives in storm across state
stories.summary: Severe storms, heavy rain, and strong winds have claimed 111 lives across Uttar Pradesh over the last two days, while large parts of the state now brace for an intense heatwave. The worst-hit districts were Prayagraj, where 21 people died, and Bhadohi, which reported 17 deaths. Russian President Vladimir Putin expressed condolences over the tragedy. In a message to Indian President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Putin said he was deeply saddened by the heavy loss of life and widespread destruction caused by the storms in Uttar Pradesh. CM Yogi orders relief measures Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath directed ministers in charge of districts to visit affected families and assess the situation on the ground. “In this hour of disaster, the government stands firmly with the people. Any negligence in relief operations will not be tolerated,” the Chief Minister said. Trees uprooted, tin roofs blown away On Thursday, strong winds accompanied by rain hit the Rajghat area, about 25 km from Lalitpur headquarters. Several trees were uprooted, while a tin roof was blown off a house. On Wednesday evening, storms lashed nearly 30 districts, including Ghaziabad, Varanasi, and Ayodhya. Rain and hailstorms damaged property in several places. Trees collapsed, electricity poles were uprooted, and vehicles were damaged after walls fell. In Bareilly, a 50-year-old man was reportedly lifted nearly 50 feet into the air along with a tin shed during winds blowing at 90 kmph. He fell into a field nearly 100 metres away and suffered a fractured arm. After treatment at a hospital, he was discharged. Wednesday's weather pictures Heatwave warning for Bundelkhand and Southern UP According to the Meteorological Department, heatwave conditions are expected on Friday in Banda, Hamirpur, Mahoba, Jhansi, Lalitpur, Prayagraj, Fatehpur, Chitrakoot, and Kaushambi. Strong gusty winds of 40 to 60 kmph, along with thunder and lightning, are likely in 37 districts across western Uttar Pradesh and the Terai region. Banda was the hottest place in the state over the past 24 hours, recording a temperature of 45.2 degrees Celsius. Lucknow-based weather scientist Atul Kumar Singh said the western disturbance influencing the weather is beginning to weaken, leading to clearer skies and a gradual rise in temperatures. From May 16 onward, heatwave conditions and extreme heat are likely to intensify in Bundelkhand and southern districts, he said. Districts under thunderstorm and gusty wind alert The weather department has issued alerts for Chitrakoot, Kaushambi, Prayagraj, Pratapgarh, Sonbhadra, Mirzapur, Chandauli, Varanasi, Bhadohi, Jaunpur, Ghazipur, Lakhimpur Kheri, Saharanpur, Shamli, Muzaffarnagar, Baghpat, Meerut, Ghaziabad, Hapur, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Bulandshahr, Aligarh, Mathura, Hathras, Kasganj, Etah, Agra, Firozabad, Bijnor, Amroha, Moradabad, Rampur, Bareilly, Pilibhit, Shahjahanpur, Sambhal, and Badaun. Currently appealing a six-month labor sentence for deepfake charges, the streamer's situation is complicated by his lawyer reportedly withdrawing. Leaked letters from detention, where he claimed to be "having fun," have also drawn public scrutiny as his appeal proceeds.
